matn.english: It necessarily involves reciprocity and parity [of the correlatives], in actuality‎ [الفعل]‎ or potentiality‎ [القوة]‎.
matn.arabic: ويجب فيه الانعكاس والتكافؤ بالفعل أو القوة

matn.english: It occurs in all existents.
matn.arabic: ويعرض للموجودات أجمع.

matn.english: Its existence‎ [الثبوت]‎ is mental; otherwise an infinite regress‎ [التسلسل]‎ would follow. Saying that relation‎ [الإضافة]‎ is relative in itself does not help.
matn.arabic: وثبوته ذهني وإلا تسلسل ولا ينفع تعلق الإضافة بذاتها. · ‎Āmulī pp. 257⁠–⁠258‎

matn.english: And because its existence‎ [الوجود]‎ would precede [its own existence].
matn.arabic: ولتقدم وجودها عليه.

matn.english: And an infinity [of relations]‎ [الإضافة]‎ would follow at every position in the series of numbers.
matn.arabic: ولزم عدم التناهي في كل مرتبة من مراتب الأعداد.

matn.english: And the attributes of God Most High would be multiplied.
matn.arabic: وتكثر صفاته تعالى.

matn.english: Every relative in ordinary usage‎ [المضاف المشهوري]‎ has its own relative in the strict sense‎ [المضاف الحقيقي]‎. Difference and agreement therefore occur in the latter. [The relation‎ [الإضافة]‎ belongs to its bearer] either through an additional factor or without one.
matn.arabic: ويخص كل مضاف مشهوري مضاف حقيقي فيعرض له الاختلاف والاتفاق إما باعتبار زائد أو لا. · ‎Āmulī pp. 259⁠–⁠260‎

matn.english: Fourth: Where, which is relation‎ [النسبة]‎ to place.
matn.arabic: الرابع الأين وهي النسبة إلى المكان.

matn.english: According to some, its species are four: motion‎ [الحركة]‎, rest‎ [السكون]‎, conjunction, and separation.
matn.arabic: وأنواعه أربعة عند قوم هي الحركة والسكون والاجتماع والافتراق.

matn.english: Motion‎ [الحركة]‎ is the first perfection‎ [الكمال الأول]‎ of what is potential, insofar as it is potential; or the body‎ [الجسم]‎'s being in one place after another.
matn.arabic: فالحركة كمال أول لما بالقوة من حيث هو بالقوة أو حصول الجسم في مكان بعد آخر.

matn.english: Its existence‎ [الوجود]‎ is self-evident.
matn.arabic: ووجودها ضروري.

matn.english: It depends on the two opposites [starting point and endpoint], the two causes [mover and moved], that to which it is referred [the category in which it occurs], and its measure [time].
matn.arabic: يتوقف على المتقابلين والعلتين والمنسوب إليه والمقدار. · ‎Āmulī pp. 261⁠–⁠262‎

matn.english: The starting point and endpoint may have the same locus, or may be contrary‎ [الضد]‎ intrinsically or accidentally.
matn.arabic: فما منه وما إليه قد يتحدان محلا وقد يتضادان ذاتا وعرضا.

matn.english: They have two opposed considerations, one with reference to that of which they are predicated [and the other with reference to each other].
matn.arabic: ولهما اعتباران متقابلان أحدهما بالنظر إلى ما يقالان له.

matn.english: If the two causes were identical, the effect‎ [المعلول]‎ [motion]‎ [الحركة]‎ would not occur.
matn.arabic: ولو اتحدت العلتان انتفى المعلول.

matn.english: And [motion]‎ [الحركة]‎ would be universal [to all bodies]‎ [الجسم]‎.
matn.arabic: وعم.

matn.english: This differs from nature, which varies and entails [motion‎ [الحركة]‎ only] in a certain condition.
matn.arabic: بخلاف الطبيعة المختلفة المستلزمة في حال ما. · ‎Āmulī pp. 263⁠–⁠264‎

matn.english: There are four [categories] to which motion‎ [الحركة]‎ is referred. For simple substances‎ [الجوهر]‎ come into existence‎ [الوجود]‎ all at once, and composite substances cease to exist when [one of] their parts ceases to exist.
matn.arabic: والمنسوب إليه أربع فإن بسائط الجواهر توجد دفعة ومركباتها تعدم بعدم أجزائها.

matn.english: The relative is dependent [on other categories].
matn.arabic: والمضاف تابع.

matn.english: So too is when.
matn.arabic: وكذا متى.

matn.english: Having comes about all at once.
matn.arabic: والجدة دفعة.

matn.english: No motion‎ [الحركة]‎ is intelligible in the categories of acting and being acted upon.
matn.arabic: ولا تعقل حركة في مقولتي الفعل والانفعال. · ‎Āmulī pp. 265⁠–⁠266‎

matn.english: In quantity‎ [الكم]‎, [motion‎ [الحركة]‎ occurs] in two respects: [rarefaction and condensation, as shown] by water entering a vessel inverted upon it, and by vessels bursting when their contents boil.
matn.arabic: ففي الكم باعتبارين لدخول الماء القارورة المكبوبة عليه ، وتصدع الآنية عند الغليان.

matn.english: And [growth, as shown] by the proportional movement of the parts of what is nourished in all dimensions.
matn.arabic: وحركة أجزاء المغتذي في جميع الأقطار على التناسب.

matn.english: In quality‎ [الكيف]‎, [motion‎ [الحركة]‎ occurs] because alteration is perceived, while concealment and influx [as explanations] are certainly false, since sense perception‎ [الحس]‎ refutes both.
matn.arabic: وفي الكيف للاستحالة المحسوسة مع الجزم ببطلان الكمون والورود لتكذيب الحس لهما.

matn.english: In place and position it is evident.
matn.arabic: وفي الأين والوضع ظاهر.

matn.english: Unity‎ [الوحدة]‎ occurs in motion‎ [الحركة]‎ through the unity of its measure, locus, and recipient.
matn.arabic: وتعرض لها وحدة باعتبار وحدة المقدار والمحل والقابل. · ‎Āmulī pp. 266⁠–⁠268‎

matn.english: Difference in the two opposites and in that to which motion‎ [الحركة]‎ is referred entails difference [in motion].
matn.arabic: واختلاف المتقابلين والمنسوب إليه يقتضي الاختلاف.

matn.english: And contrariety‎ [التضاد]‎ in the first two entails contrariety [of motions]‎ [الحركة]‎.
matn.arabic: وتضاد الأولين التضاد.

matn.english: Neither the two opposites nor the agent has a role in [motion‎ [الحركة]‎'s] division.
matn.arabic: ولا مدخل للمتقابلين والفاعل في الانقسام.

matn.english: Motion‎ [الحركة]‎ has a quality‎ [الكيفية]‎ that makes it fast when intensified and slow when weakened. The quiddity‎ [الماهية]‎ of motion does not differ on that account.
matn.arabic: وتعرض لها كيفية تشتد فتكون الحركة سريعة ، وتضعف فتكون بطيئة ولا تختلف بهما الماهية.

matn.english: The cause‎ [السبب]‎ of slowness is external or internal resistance, not intervening rests; otherwise what possesses the opposite [speed] would not be perceived.
matn.arabic: وسبب البطء الممانعة الخارجية أو الداخلية لا تخلل السكنات وإلا لما أحس بما اتصف بالمقابل. · ‎Āmulī pp. 268⁠–⁠270‎

matn.english: Motions‎ [الحركة]‎ involving angles or reversal are not continuous, because an interval of time lies between the two instants of inclination‎ [الميل]‎.
matn.arabic: ولا اتصال لذوات الزوايا والانعطاف لوجود زمان بين آني الميلين. · ‎Āmulī pp. 270‎

matn.english: Rest‎ [السكون]‎ preserves relations‎ [النسبة]‎; it is therefore a contrary‎ [الضد]‎ [of motion]‎ [الحركة]‎.
matn.arabic: والسكون حفظ النسب فهو ضد.

matn.english: It is opposed to both motions‎ [الحركة]‎ [toward and away from the place of rest].
matn.arabic: يقابل الحركتين.

matn.english: Outside the category of where, [rest‎ [السكون]‎ is] the preservation of the species [of state within the category].
matn.arabic: وفي غير الأين حفظ النوع.

matn.english: Instances of rest‎ [السكون]‎ are contrary‎ [الضد]‎ because what they occur in is contrary.
matn.arabic: ويتضاد لتضاد ما فيه.

matn.english: Among spatial states [motion‎ [الحركة]‎ and rest]‎ [السكون]‎, some are natural, some forced, and some voluntary.
matn.arabic: ومن الكون طبيعي وقسري وإرادي. · ‎Āmulī pp. 271⁠–⁠272‎

matn.english: Natural motion‎ [الحركة]‎ occurs only when something unnatural accompanies [the body]‎ [الجسم]‎.
matn.arabic: فطبيعي الحركة إنما يحصل عند مقارنة أمر غير طبيعي.

matn.english: To return the body‎ [الجسم]‎ to its natural condition, at which point it comes to rest‎ [السكون]‎.
matn.arabic: ليرد الجسم إليه فيقف

matn.english: Thus it cannot be circular.
matn.arabic: فلا تكون دورية

matn.english: Forced motion‎ [الحركة]‎ rests on an acquired force‎ [القوة]‎ capable of weakening.
matn.arabic: وقسريها مستند إلى قوة مستفادة قابلة للضعف.

matn.english: Natural rest‎ [السكون]‎ is grounded in nature without qualification.
matn.arabic: وطبيعي السكون يستند إلى الطبيعة مطلقا. · ‎Āmulī pp. 272⁠–⁠274‎

matn.english: Simplicity‎ [البساطة]‎ and its opposite [composition]‎ [التركيب]‎ occur in motion‎ [الحركة]‎ alone [among these spatial states].
matn.arabic: وتعرض البساطة ومقابلها للحركة خاصة.

matn.english: Neither the genus‎ [الجنس]‎ nor its species is explained by what entails circularity‎ [الدور]‎.
matn.arabic: ولا يعلل الجنس ولا أنواعه بما يقتضي الدور. · ‎Āmulī pp. 274‎

matn.english: Fifth: When, which is relation‎ [النسبة]‎ to time or its extremity.
matn.arabic: الخامس المتى وهو النسبة إلى الزمان أو طرفه.

matn.english: Time is the measure of motion‎ [الحركة]‎ in respect of priority‎ [التقدم]‎ and posteriority, which belong to motion under a different consideration [that of distance, rather than time itself].
matn.arabic: والزمان مقدار الحركة من حيث التقدم والتأخر العارضين لها باعتبار آخر.

matn.english: This category belongs intrinsically to changing things, and accidentally to their bearer.
matn.arabic: وإنما تعرض المقولة بالذات للمتغيرات ، وبالعرض لمعروضها.

matn.english: The existence‎ [الوجود]‎ and nonexistence‎ [العدم]‎ of its bearer do not depend on time.
matn.arabic: ولا يفتقر وجود معروضها وعدمه إليه.

matn.english: The extremity [the instant] is like the point; its nonexistence‎ [العدم]‎ occurs in time without being gradual.
matn.arabic: والطرف كالنقطة وعدمه في الزمان لا على التدريج. · ‎Āmulī pp. 275⁠–⁠276‎

matn.english: The origination‎ [الحدوث]‎ of the world entails the origination of time.
matn.arabic: وحدوث العالم يستلزم حدوثه. · ‎Āmulī pp. 276‎

matn.english: Sixth: Position, a configuration occurring in a body‎ [الجسم]‎ in respect of two relations‎ [النسبة]‎ [among its parts, and between its parts and external things].
matn.arabic: السادس الوضع وهو هيئة تعرض للجسم باعتبار نسبتين.

matn.english: It admits contrariety‎ [التضاد]‎, intensity, and weakness.
matn.arabic: وفيه تضاد وشدة وضعف. · ‎Āmulī pp. 276⁠–⁠277‎

matn.english: Seventh: Possession‎ [الملك]‎, which is the relation‎ [النسبة]‎ of having.
matn.arabic: السابع الملك وهو نسبة التملك. · ‎Āmulī pp. 277‎

matn.english: Eighth and Ninth: Acting and Being Acted Upon.
matn.arabic: الثامن والتاسع أن يفعل وأن ينفعل.

matn.english: The truth is that these two have mental existence‎ [الوجود الذهني]‎; otherwise an infinite regress‎ [التسلسل]‎ would follow.
matn.arabic: والحق ثبوتها ذهنا وإلا لزم التسلسل. · ‎Āmulī pp. 278‎

matn.english: If an existent is necessary, [the desired conclusion follows]; otherwise, it entails [a necessary existent]‎ [واجب الوجود]‎, since circular dependence‎ [الدور]‎ and infinite regress‎ [التسلسل]‎ are impossible.
matn.arabic: الموجود إن كان واجبا وإلا استلزمه لاستحالة الدور والتسلسل. · ‎Āmulī pp. 279⁠–⁠280‎
matn.division: Division 3 · Establishing the Maker, exalted is He, His attributes, and His effects
matn.chapter: Chapter 1 · His existence, exalted is He

matn.english: The existence‎ [الوجود]‎ of the world after its nonexistence‎ [العدم]‎ excludes necessitation‎ [الإيجاب]‎ [by its cause].
matn.arabic: وجود العالم بعد عدمه ينفي الإيجاب.
matn.division: Division 3 · Establishing the Maker, exalted is He, His attributes, and His effects

matn.english: An intermediary [between God and everything other than Him] is unintelligible.
matn.arabic: والواسطة غير معقولة.
matn.division: Division 3 · Establishing the Maker, exalted is He, His attributes, and His effects

matn.english: Necessity‎ [الوجوب]‎ and possibility‎ [الإمكان]‎ can accrue to an effect under two [different] considerations.
matn.arabic: ويمكن عروض الوجوب والإمكان للأثر باعتبارين.
matn.division: Division 3 · Establishing the Maker, exalted is He, His attributes, and His effects

matn.english: And power‎ [القدرة]‎ [to produce an effect] in the future can coexist with [its present] nonexistence‎ [العدم]‎.
matn.arabic: واجتماع القدرة على المستقبل مع العدم.
matn.division: Division 3 · Establishing the Maker, exalted is He, His attributes, and His effects

matn.english: The absence of an act is not the performance of its contrary.
matn.arabic: وانتفاء الفعل ليس فعل الضد. · ‎Āmulī pp. 281⁠–⁠283‎
matn.division: Division 3 · Establishing the Maker, exalted is He, His attributes, and His effects

matn.english: The universality of the ground [of being subject to power]‎ [القدرة]‎ entails the universality of the attribute [of power].
matn.arabic: وعمومية العلة تستلزم عمومية الصفة. · ‎Āmulī pp. 283‎
matn.division: Division 3 · Establishing the Maker, exalted is He, His attributes, and His effects

matn.english: [The world’s] perfected order, [His] immateriality‎ [التجرد]‎, and the dependence of everything upon Him are proofs of [His] knowledge‎ [العلم]‎.
matn.arabic: والإحكام والتجرد واستناد كل شيء إليه دلائل العلم.
matn.division: Division 3 · Establishing the Maker, exalted is He, His attributes, and His effects

matn.english: The last [proof] is universal [in its scope].
matn.arabic: والأخير عام.
matn.division: Division 3 · Establishing the Maker, exalted is He, His attributes, and His effects

matn.english: The distinction [between knower and known in self-knowledge]‎ [العلم]‎ is one of consideration.
matn.arabic: والتغاير اعتباري.
matn.division: Division 3 · Establishing the Maker, exalted is He, His attributes, and His effects

matn.english: Knowledge‎ [العلم]‎ does not require forms distinct from the things known [to be present] with Him, because the relation of [those things’] presence to Him is stronger than the relation of intelligible forms‎ [الصور المعقولة]‎ to us.
matn.arabic: ولا يستدعي العلم صورا مغايرة للمعلومات عنده لأن نسبة الحصول إليه أشد من نسبة الصور المعقولة لنا.
matn.division: Division 3 · Establishing the Maker, exalted is He, His attributes, and His effects

matn.english: Change in relations is possible [without change in His essence].
matn.arabic: وتغير الإضافات ممكن. · ‎Āmulī pp. 284⁠–⁠286‎
matn.division: Division 3 · Establishing the Maker, exalted is He, His attributes, and His effects

matn.english: Necessity‎ [الوجوب]‎ and possibility‎ [الإمكان]‎ can coexist under two [different] considerations.
matn.arabic: ويمكن اجتماع الوجوب والإمكان باعتبارين. · ‎Āmulī pp. 287‎
matn.division: Division 3 · Establishing the Maker, exalted is He, His attributes, and His effects

matn.english: Whatever possesses power‎ [القدرة]‎ and knowledge‎ [العلم]‎ is necessarily living.
matn.arabic: وكل قادر عالم حي بالضرورة. · ‎Āmulī pp. 287‎
matn.division: Division 3 · Establishing the Maker, exalted is He, His attributes, and His effects

matn.english: Singling out some possible things for existence‎ [الوجود]‎ at a [particular] time indicates His will‎ [الإرادة]‎, exalted is He.
matn.arabic: وتخصيص بعض الممكنات بالإيجاد في وقت يدل على إرادته تعالى.
matn.division: Division 3 · Establishing the Maker, exalted is He, His attributes, and His effects

matn.english: It is not additional to the motive‎ [الداعي]‎ [for acting]; otherwise, an infinite regress‎ [التسلسل]‎ or a plurality of beginningless entities would follow.
matn.arabic: وليست زائدة على الداعي وإلا لزم التسلسل أو تعدد القدماء. · ‎Āmulī pp. 288‎
matn.division: Division 3 · Establishing the Maker, exalted is He, His attributes, and His effects

matn.english: Transmitted revelation‎ [النقل]‎ indicates that He possesses perception‎ [الإدراك]‎, and reason‎ [العقل]‎ [indicates] the impossibility of [His having perceptual] organs.
matn.arabic: والنقل دل على اتصافه بالإدراك والعقل على استحالة الآلات. · ‎Āmulī pp. 289‎
matn.division: Division 3 · Establishing the Maker, exalted is He, His attributes, and His effects

matn.english: The universality of His power‎ [القدرة]‎ indicates that speech‎ [الكلام]‎ is established [for Him]; internal speech‎ [الكلام النفسي]‎ (kalām nafsī) [as a distinct attribute] is unintelligible.
matn.arabic: وعمومية قدرته تدل على ثبوت الكلام والنفساني غير معقول.
matn.division: Division 3 · Establishing the Maker, exalted is He, His attributes, and His effects

matn.english: The absence of badness‎ [القبح]‎ from Him, exalted is He, indicates His truthfulness‎ [الصدق]‎.
matn.arabic: وانتفاء القبح عنه تعالى يدل على صدقه. · ‎Āmulī pp. 289⁠–⁠290‎
matn.division: Division 3 · Establishing the Maker, exalted is He, His attributes, and His effects

matn.english: Necessity of existence‎ [وجوب الوجود]‎ indicates His eternity‎ [السرمدية]‎ and the negation of an additional [attribute of subsistence].
matn.arabic: ووجوب الوجود يدل على سرمديته ونفي الزائد.
matn.division: Division 3 · Establishing the Maker, exalted is He, His attributes, and His effects

matn.english: And [it negates] a partner.
matn.arabic: والشريك
matn.division: Division 3 · Establishing the Maker, exalted is He, His attributes, and His effects

matn.english: And a like.
matn.arabic: والمثل.
matn.division: Division 3 · Establishing the Maker, exalted is He, His attributes, and His effects

matn.english: And composition in its [various] senses.
matn.arabic: والتركيب بمعانيه.
matn.division: Division 3 · Establishing the Maker, exalted is He, His attributes, and His effects

matn.english: And a contrary.
matn.arabic: والضد. · ‎Āmulī pp. 290⁠–⁠292‎
matn.division: Division 3 · Establishing the Maker, exalted is He, His attributes, and His effects

matn.english: And spatial occupation‎ [التحيز]‎.
matn.arabic: والتحيز.
matn.division: Division 3 · Establishing the Maker, exalted is He, His attributes, and His effects

matn.english: And inherence‎ [الحلول]‎ [in another].
matn.arabic: والحلول.
matn.division: Division 3 · Establishing the Maker, exalted is He, His attributes, and His effects

matn.english: And union‎ [الاتحاد]‎ [with another].
matn.arabic: والاتحاد.
matn.division: Division 3 · Establishing the Maker, exalted is He, His attributes, and His effects

matn.english: And [location in a] direction.
matn.arabic: والجهة.
matn.division: Division 3 · Establishing the Maker, exalted is He, His attributes, and His effects

matn.english: And the inherence‎ [الحلول]‎ of temporally originated things in Him.
matn.arabic: وحلول الحوادث فيه. · ‎Āmulī pp. 293⁠–⁠294‎
matn.division: Division 3 · Establishing the Maker, exalted is He, His attributes, and His effects

matn.english: And need.
matn.arabic: والحاجة.
matn.division: Division 3 · Establishing the Maker, exalted is He, His attributes, and His effects

matn.english: And pain absolutely, and pleasure arising from bodily temperament‎ [المزاج]‎.
matn.arabic: والألم مطلقا واللذة المزاجية.
matn.division: Division 3 · Establishing the Maker, exalted is He, His attributes, and His effects

matn.english: And entitative attributes‎ [المعاني]‎ (maʿānī), states‎ [الأحوال]‎ (aḥwāl), and attributes additional [to the essence] in concrete reality.
matn.arabic: والمعاني والأحوال والصفات الزائدة عينا. · ‎Āmulī pp. 295⁠–⁠296‎
matn.division: Division 3 · Establishing the Maker, exalted is He, His attributes, and His effects

matn.english: And [His being an object of visual] seeing‎ [الرؤية]‎.
matn.arabic: والرؤية.
matn.division: Division 3 · Establishing the Maker, exalted is He, His attributes, and His effects

matn.english: Moses’ request [to see God] was on behalf of his people.
matn.arabic: وسؤال موسى لقومه.
matn.division: Division 3 · Establishing the Maker, exalted is He, His attributes, and His effects

matn.english: Looking does not imply seeing‎ [الرؤية]‎; moreover, [the relevant expression] admits of interpretation.
matn.arabic: والنظر لا يدل على الرؤية مع قبوله التأويل.
matn.division: Division 3 · Establishing the Maker, exalted is He, His attributes, and His effects

matn.english: Making seeing‎ [الرؤية]‎ conditional upon the moving mountain’s remaining still does not indicate [the] possibility‎ [الإمكان]‎ [of seeing God].
matn.arabic: وتعليق الرؤية على استقرار الجبل المتحرك لا يدل على الإمكان.
matn.division: Division 3 · Establishing the Maker, exalted is He, His attributes, and His effects

matn.english: A common feature among effects does not indicate a common feature among their causes; moreover, [the need for] causal explanation and the exhaustiveness [of the proposed alternatives] are denied.
matn.arabic: واشتراك المعلولات لا يدل على اشتراك العلل مع منع التعليل والحصر. · ‎Āmulī pp. 296⁠–⁠298‎
matn.division: Division 3 · Establishing the Maker, exalted is He, His attributes, and His effects

matn.english: And [necessity of existence‎ [وجوب الوجود]‎ indicates] the establishment of generosity‎ [الجود]‎ [in Him].
matn.arabic: وعلى ثبوت الجود.
matn.division: Division 3 · Establishing the Maker, exalted is He, His attributes, and His effects

matn.english: And sovereignty‎ [الملك]‎.
matn.arabic: والملك.
matn.division: Division 3 · Establishing the Maker, exalted is He, His attributes, and His effects

matn.english: And completeness‎ [التمام]‎, and being above completeness.
matn.arabic: والتمام وفوقه.
matn.division: Division 3 · Establishing the Maker, exalted is He, His attributes, and His effects

matn.english: And being the Real‎ [الحق]‎ (al-ḥaqq).
matn.arabic: والحقية.
matn.division: Division 3 · Establishing the Maker, exalted is He, His attributes, and His effects

matn.english: And goodness‎ [الخيرية]‎ (khayriyya).
matn.arabic: والخيرية. · ‎Āmulī pp. 299⁠–⁠300‎
matn.division: Division 3 · Establishing the Maker, exalted is He, His attributes, and His effects

matn.english: And wisdom‎ [الحكمة]‎.
matn.arabic: والحكمة.
matn.division: Division 3 · Establishing the Maker, exalted is He, His attributes, and His effects

matn.english: And compelling might‎ [التجبر]‎ (tajabbur).
matn.arabic: والتجبر.
matn.division: Division 3 · Establishing the Maker, exalted is He, His attributes, and His effects

matn.english: And overpowering dominion‎ [القهر]‎ (qahr).
matn.arabic: والقهر. · ‎Āmulī pp. 301‎
matn.division: Division 3 · Establishing the Maker, exalted is He, His attributes, and His effects

matn.english: And self-subsistence and the sustaining of others‎ [القيومية]‎ (qayyūmiyya).
matn.arabic: والقيومية.
matn.division: Division 3 · Establishing the Maker, exalted is He, His attributes, and His effects

matn.english: As for hand, face, beginninglessness‎ [القدم]‎, mercy, munificence, good pleasure and bringing into being‎ [التكوين]‎, they refer back to what has preceded.
matn.arabic: وأما اليد والوجه والقدم والرحمة والكرم والرضا والتكوين فراجعة إلى ما تقدم. · ‎Āmulī pp. 301‎
matn.division: Division 3 · Establishing the Maker, exalted is He, His attributes, and His effects

matn.english: An act characterised by something additional [to its occurrence] is either good‎ [الحسن]‎ or bad‎ [القبيح]‎; the good has four kinds.
matn.arabic: الفعل المتصف بالزائد إما حسن أو قبيح والحسن أربعة.
matn.division: Division 3 · Establishing the Maker, exalted is He, His attributes, and His effects

matn.english: Both [goodness‎ [الحسن]‎ and badness]‎ [القبح]‎ are rationally knowable, because the goodness of beneficence‎ [الإحسان]‎ and the badness of injustice‎ [الظلم]‎ are known without revelation.
matn.arabic: وهما عقليان للعلم بحسن الإحسان وقبح الظلم من غير شرع.
matn.division: Division 3 · Establishing the Maker, exalted is He, His attributes, and His effects

matn.english: And because both would disappear altogether if they were established [only] through revelation.
matn.arabic: ولانتفائهما مطلقا لو ثبتا شرعا.
matn.division: Division 3 · Establishing the Maker, exalted is He, His attributes, and His effects

matn.english: And [otherwise] their reversal would be possible.
matn.arabic: ولجاز التعاكس.
matn.division: Division 3 · Establishing the Maker, exalted is He, His attributes, and His effects

matn.english: Differences in [the evidentness of] cognitions are possible because of differences in conceptualisation.
matn.arabic: ويجوز التفاوت في العلوم لتفاوت التصور. · ‎Āmulī pp. 302⁠–⁠304‎
matn.division: Division 3 · Establishing the Maker, exalted is He, His attributes, and His effects

matn.english: And [the reply is] undertaking the less bad of two bad acts, together with the possibility‎ [الإمكان]‎ of a way out [of the dilemma].
matn.arabic: وارتكاب أقل القبيحين مع إمكان المخلص.
matn.division: Division 3 · Establishing the Maker, exalted is He, His attributes, and His effects

matn.english: And compulsion‎ [الجبر]‎ [as an account of human action] is false.
matn.arabic: والجبر باطل. · ‎Āmulī pp. 304⁠–⁠305‎
matn.division: Division 3 · Establishing the Maker, exalted is He, His attributes, and His effects

matn.english: His independence and His knowledge‎ [العلم]‎ indicate the absence of badness‎ [القبح]‎ from His acts, exalted is He.
matn.arabic: واستغناؤه وعلمه يدلان على انتفاء القبح عن أفعاله تعالى.
matn.division: Division 3 · Establishing the Maker, exalted is He, His attributes, and His effects

matn.english: Although He has power‎ [القدرة]‎ over it [the bad], because [His power’s] relation is universal; consequent impossibility‎ [الامتناع اللاحق]‎ does not conflict [with this power].
matn.arabic: مع قدرته عليه لعموم النسبة ولا ينافي الامتناع اللاحق. · ‎Āmulī pp. 305⁠–⁠306‎
matn.division: Division 3 · Establishing the Maker, exalted is He, His attributes, and His effects

matn.english: Denying a purpose entails pointlessness; [the benefit of] the purpose need not return to Him.
matn.arabic: ونفي الغرض يستلزم العبث ولا يلزم عوده إليه. · ‎Āmulī pp. 306‎
matn.division: Division 3 · Establishing the Maker, exalted is He, His attributes, and His effects

matn.english: Willing the bad is bad, as is failing to will the good; and [the same conclusion follows] from command and prohibition.
matn.arabic: وإرادة القبيح قبيحة وكذا ترك إرادة الحسن وللأمر والنهي
matn.division: Division 3 · Establishing the Maker, exalted is He, His attributes, and His effects

matn.english: Some acts depend upon us; [God’s] being overcome does not follow, and knowledge‎ [العلم]‎ follows [the thing known].
matn.arabic: وبعض الأفعال مستندة إلينا والمغلوبية غير لازمة والعلم تابع. · ‎Āmulī pp. 307‎
matn.division: Division 3 · Establishing the Maker, exalted is He, His attributes, and His effects

matn.english: It is immediately certain that our acts depend upon us.
matn.arabic: والضرورة قاضية باستناد أفعالنا إلينا.
matn.division: Division 3 · Establishing the Maker, exalted is He, His attributes, and His effects

matn.english: Necessity‎ [الوجوب]‎ due to a motive‎ [الداعي]‎ does not conflict with power‎ [القدرة]‎, as [is also the case] with the Necessary Existent‎ [واجب الوجود]‎.
matn.arabic: والوجوب للداعي لا ينافي القدرة كالواجب.
matn.division: Division 3 · Establishing the Maker, exalted is He, His attributes, and His effects

matn.english: Bringing into existence‎ [الإيجاد]‎ does not entail knowledge‎ [العلم]‎ unless accompanied by intention‎ [القصد]‎; then general knowledge suffices.
matn.arabic: والإيجاد لا يستلزم العلم إلا مع اقتران القصد فيكفي الإجمال.
matn.division: Division 3 · Establishing the Maker, exalted is He, His attributes, and His effects

matn.english: When [the two powers] come together, what He wills, exalted is He, occurs.
matn.arabic: ومع الاجتماع يقع مراده تعالى.
matn.division: Division 3 · Establishing the Maker, exalted is He, His attributes, and His effects

matn.english: Temporal origination‎ [الحدوث]‎ is a matter of consideration.
matn.arabic: والحدوث اعتباري. · ‎Āmulī pp. 308⁠–⁠310‎
matn.division: Division 3 · Establishing the Maker, exalted is He, His attributes, and His effects

matn.english: The impossibility of [our producing] a body is due to something other than [temporal origination]‎ [الحدوث]‎.
matn.arabic: وامتناع الجسم لغيره.
matn.division: Division 3 · Establishing the Maker, exalted is He, His attributes, and His effects

matn.english: The inability to produce an exact likeness in some acts is due to the inability to comprehend [all their details].
matn.arabic: وتعذر المماثلة في بعض الأفعال لتعذر الإحاطة.
matn.division: Division 3 · Establishing the Maker, exalted is He, His attributes, and His effects

matn.english: There is no comparison in goodness‎ [الخيرية]‎ between our act and His act, exalted is He.
matn.arabic: ولا نسبة في الخيرية بين فعلنا وفعله تعالى.
matn.division: Division 3 · Establishing the Maker, exalted is He, His attributes, and His effects

matn.english: Gratitude [to God] is for the prerequisites of faith‎ [الإيمان]‎.
matn.arabic: والشكر على مقدمات الإيمان.
matn.division: Division 3 · Establishing the Maker, exalted is He, His attributes, and His effects

matn.english: The transmitted evidence‎ [السمع]‎ [adduced against us] is interpreted and countered by its like; the grounds for preference favour us.
matn.arabic: والسمع متأول ومعارض بمثله والترجيح معنا. · ‎Āmulī pp. 310⁠–⁠311‎
matn.division: Division 3 · Establishing the Maker, exalted is He, His attributes, and His effects

matn.english: The goodness‎ [الحسن]‎ of praise and blame for a generated act‎ [الفعل المتولد]‎ entails knowledge‎ [العلم]‎ that it is attributable to us.
matn.arabic: وحسن المدح والذم على المتولد يقتضي العلم بإضافته إلينا.
matn.division: Division 3 · Establishing the Maker, exalted is He, His attributes, and His effects

matn.english: The necessity‎ [الوجوب]‎ [of the effect] through choosing its cause is consequent [necessity].
matn.arabic: والوجوب باختيار السبب لاحق.
matn.division: Division 3 · Establishing the Maker, exalted is He, His attributes, and His effects

matn.english: In casting a child [into fire], blame concerns that [casting], not the burning.
matn.arabic: والذم في إلقاء الصبي عليه لا على الإحراق. · ‎Āmulī pp. 313⁠–⁠315‎
matn.division: Division 3 · Establishing the Maker, exalted is He, His attributes, and His effects

matn.english: If divine decree‎ [القضاء]‎ and determination‎ [القدر]‎ (qaḍāʾ and qadar) mean the creation of the [human] act, an impossibility follows; if they mean imposing obligation‎ [الإلزام]‎, [the assertion] is true only of what is obligatory; if they mean making known, it is true without restriction. The Commander of the Faithful, peace be upon him, explained this in the report of al-Aṣbagh.
matn.arabic: والقضاء والقدر إن أريد بهما خلق الفعل لزم المحال أو الإلزام صح في الواجب خاصة أو الإعلام صح مطلقا وقد بينه أمير المؤمنين عليه‌السلام في حديث الأصبغ. · ‎Āmulī pp. 315‎
matn.division: Division 3 · Establishing the Maker, exalted is He, His attributes, and His effects

matn.english: Leading astray means pointing towards what is contrary to the truth, producing misguidance, or causing destruction. Guidance has the corresponding opposite senses. The first two [senses of leading astray] are denied of Him, exalted is He.
matn.arabic: والإضلال الإشارة إلى خلاف الحق وفعل الضلالة والإهلاك والهدى مقابل والأولان منفيان عنه تعالى. · ‎Āmulī pp. 317‎
matn.division: Division 3 · Establishing the Maker, exalted is He, His attributes, and His effects

matn.english: Punishing someone not subject to moral obligation‎ [التكليف]‎ is bad. Noah’s words, peace be upon him, are figurative; [a child’s] service is not a punishment‎ [العقوبة]‎ of him; and derivative status in some rulings is permissible.
matn.arabic: وتعذيب غير المكلف قبيح وكلام نوح عليه‌السلام مجاز والخدمة ليست عقوبة له والتبعية في بعض الأحكام جائزة. · ‎Āmulī pp. 318‎
matn.division: Division 3 · Establishing the Maker, exalted is He, His attributes, and His effects

matn.english: Imposing moral obligation‎ [التكليف]‎ (taklīf) is good because it contains a benefit that cannot be obtained without it.
matn.arabic: والتكليف حسن لاشتماله على مصلحة لا تحصل بدونه.
matn.division: Division 3 · Establishing the Maker, exalted is He, His attributes, and His effects

matn.english: It differs from wounding and then treating [the wound], and from exchanges; [explaining it as repayment in] gratitude is invalid.
matn.arabic: بخلاف الجرح ثم التداوي ، والمعاوضات والشكر باطل.
matn.division: Division 3 · Establishing the Maker, exalted is He, His attributes, and His effects

matn.english: And because the [human] species needs mutual assistance, which requires an established law whose practice benefits [spiritual] discipline, sustained reflection upon higher matters, and recollection of warnings that lead to the establishment of justice‎ [العدل]‎, together with increased recompense and reward‎ [الثواب]‎.
matn.arabic: ولأن النوع محتاج إلى التعاضد المستلزم للسنة النافع استعمالها في الرياضة وإدامة النظر في الأمور العالية ، وتذكر الإنذارات المستلزمة لإقامة العدل مع زيادة الأجر والثواب.
matn.division: Division 3 · Establishing the Maker, exalted is He, His attributes, and His effects

matn.english: And [imposing moral obligation]‎ [التكليف]‎ is obligatory because it restrains [people] from bad acts.
matn.arabic: وواجب لزجره عن القبائح. · ‎Āmulī pp. 319⁠–⁠321‎
matn.division: Division 3 · Establishing the Maker, exalted is He, His attributes, and His effects

matn.english: The conditions of its goodness‎ [الحسن]‎ are: the absence of a harmful consequence [of imposing the obligation]; its preceding [the act]; the possibility‎ [الإمكان]‎ of its object; the presence [in the act] of an attribute additional to its goodness; the imposer’s knowledge‎ [العلم]‎ of the act’s attributes and of the amount deserved [in reward]‎ [الثواب]‎, his power‎ [القدرة]‎ to [deliver] it, and the impossibility of badness‎ [القبح]‎ on his part; and the obligated person‎ [المكلف]‎’s power to perform the act, his knowledge of it or ability [to acquire that knowledge], and the availability of the [required] instrument.
matn.arabic: وشرائط حسنه انتفاء المفسدة وتقدمه وإمكان متعلقه وثبوت صفة زائدة على حسنه وعلم المكلف بصفات الفعل وقدر المستحق وقدرته عليه وامتناع القبيح عليه وقدرة المكلف على الفعل وعلمه به أو إمكانه وإمكان الآلة.
matn.division: Division 3 · Establishing the Maker, exalted is He, His attributes, and His effects

matn.english: Its object is either knowledge‎ [العلم]‎, rational or transmitted; probable judgment‎ [الظن]‎; or action.
matn.arabic: ومتعلقه إما علم إما عقلي أو سمعي وإما ظن وإما عمل. · ‎Āmulī pp. 322‎
matn.division: Division 3 · Establishing the Maker, exalted is He, His attributes, and His effects

matn.english: It comes to an end, [as shown] by consensus‎ [الإجماع]‎ and [the need] to deliver reward‎ [الثواب]‎.
matn.arabic: وهو منقطع للإجماع ولإيصال الثواب.
matn.division: Division 3 · Establishing the Maker, exalted is He, His attributes, and His effects

matn.english: The ground of its goodness‎ [الحسن]‎ is universal [for believer and unbeliever].
matn.arabic: وعلة حسنه عامة.
matn.division: Division 3 · Establishing the Maker, exalted is He, His attributes, and His effects

matn.english: The unbeliever’s harm comes from his own choice.
matn.arabic: وضرر الكافر من اختياره.
matn.division: Division 3 · Establishing the Maker, exalted is He, His attributes, and His effects

matn.english: It is a harm, but not insofar as [it arises from] the imposition of obligation‎ [التكليف]‎, unlike what we stipulated [must be absent].
matn.arabic: وهو مفسدة لا من حيث التكليف بخلاف ما شرطناه.
matn.division: Division 3 · Establishing the Maker, exalted is He, His attributes, and His effects

matn.english: And the benefit [of offering the opportunity for reward]‎ [الثواب]‎ is established.
matn.arabic: والفائدة ثابتة. · ‎Āmulī pp. 323⁠–⁠324‎
matn.division: Division 3 · Establishing the Maker, exalted is He, His attributes, and His effects

matn.english: Gracious assistance‎ [اللطف]‎ (luṭf) is obligatory because the purpose is attained through it.
matn.arabic: واللطف واجب لتحصيل الغرض به.
matn.division: Division 3 · Establishing the Maker, exalted is He, His attributes, and His effects

matn.english: If it is His act, exalted is He, it is obligatory upon Him. If it is the obligated person‎ [المكلف]‎’s act, He must make him aware of it and require him to perform it. If it is the act of someone other than those two, knowing that the act [of assistance] will occur is a condition of [imposing] the obligation.
matn.arabic: فإن كان من فعله تعالى وجب عليه وإن كان من المكلف وجب أن يشعره به ويوجبه وإن كان من غيرهما شرط في التكليف العلم بالفعل.
matn.division: Division 3 · Establishing the Maker, exalted is He, His attributes, and His effects

matn.english: The grounds of badness‎ [القبح]‎ are absent [from it]; the unbeliever is not without gracious assistance‎ [اللطف]‎; and announcing [someone’s future] felicity or wretchedness is not a corrupting influence.
matn.arabic: ووجوه القبح منتفية والكافر لا يخلو من لطف والإخبار بالسعادة والشقاوة ليس مفسدة. · ‎Āmulī pp. 324⁠–⁠325‎
matn.division: Division 3 · Establishing the Maker, exalted is He, His attributes, and His effects

matn.english: For Him, exalted is He, to punish while withholding it [gracious assistance]‎ [اللطف]‎ would be bad; to blame while withholding it would not.
matn.arabic: ويقبح منه تعالى التعذيب مع منعه دون الذم.
matn.division: Division 3 · Establishing the Maker, exalted is He, His attributes, and His effects

matn.english: There must be a correspondence [between the assistance and the act assisted]; otherwise, there would be preference without a preferring ground in relation to the two related terms.
matn.arabic: ولا بد من المناسبة وإلا ترجح بلا مرجح بالنسبة إلى المنتسبين.
matn.division: Division 3 · Establishing the Maker, exalted is He, His attributes, and His effects

matn.english: It does not reach the point of compulsion‎ [الإلجاء]‎.
matn.arabic: ولا يبلغ الإلجاء.
matn.division: Division 3 · Establishing the Maker, exalted is He, His attributes, and His effects

matn.english: The obligated person‎ [المكلف]‎ must know the gracious assistance‎ [اللطف]‎, generally or in detail.
matn.arabic: ويعلم المكلف اللطف إجمالا أو تفصيلا.
matn.division: Division 3 · Establishing the Maker, exalted is He, His attributes, and His effects

matn.english: Gracious assistance‎ [اللطف]‎ has an aspect additional to [mere] goodness‎ [الحسن]‎.
matn.arabic: ويزيد اللطف على جهة الحسن. · ‎Āmulī pp. 327⁠–⁠328‎
matn.division: Division 3 · Establishing the Maker, exalted is He, His attributes, and His effects

matn.english: It admits of a choice [between alternatives].
matn.arabic: ويدخله التخيير.
matn.division: Division 3 · Establishing the Maker, exalted is He, His attributes, and His effects

matn.english: Provided that both alternatives are good.
matn.arabic: بشرط حسن البدلين. · ‎Āmulī pp. 328‎
matn.division: Division 3 · Establishing the Maker, exalted is He, His attributes, and His effects

matn.english: Some pain is bad and proceeds from us alone; some is good and proceeds from Him, exalted is He, and from us. Its goodness‎ [الحسن]‎ is either because it is deserved, because it includes a greater benefit or averts a greater harm, because it occurs according to the customary order [of causes], or because it is inflicted in defence.
matn.arabic: وبعض الألم قبيح يصدر منا خاصة وبعضه حسن يصدر منه تعالى ومنا وحسنه إما لاستحقاقه أو لاشتماله على النفع أو دفع الضرر الزائدين أو لكونه عاديا أو على وجه الدفع.
matn.division: Division 3 · Establishing the Maker, exalted is He, His attributes, and His effects

matn.english: In [pain] that contains benefit, gracious assistance‎ [اللطف]‎ is also necessary.
matn.arabic: ولا بد في المشتمل على النفع من اللطف.
matn.division: Division 3 · Establishing the Maker, exalted is He, His attributes, and His effects

matn.english: Where [pain] is deserved, it may be punishment‎ [العقاب]‎.
matn.arabic: ويجوز في المستحق كونه عقابا.
matn.division: Division 3 · Establishing the Maker, exalted is He, His attributes, and His effects

matn.english: Gracious assistance‎ [اللطف]‎ alone does not suffice for the goodness‎ [الحسن]‎ of pain inflicted upon an obligated person‎ [المكلف]‎.
matn.arabic: ولا يكفي اللطف في ألم المكلف في الحسن.
matn.division: Division 3 · Establishing the Maker, exalted is He, His attributes, and His effects

matn.english: Nor is [pain] good when pleasure would provide its [same] gracious assistance‎ [اللطف]‎.
matn.arabic: ولا يحسن مع اشتمال اللذة على لطفيته. · ‎Āmulī pp. 329⁠–⁠331‎
matn.division: Division 3 · Establishing the Maker, exalted is He, His attributes, and His effects

matn.english: The actual choice of the person suffering is not a condition of [the pain’s] goodness‎ [الحسن]‎.
matn.arabic: ولا يشترط في الحسن اختيار المتألم بالفعل. · ‎Āmulī pp. 332‎
matn.division: Division 3 · Establishing the Maker, exalted is He, His attributes, and His effects

matn.english: Compensation‎ [العوض]‎ (ʿiwaḍ) is a deserved benefit devoid of honour and exaltation.
matn.arabic: والعوض نفع مستحق خال عن تعظيم وإجلال.
matn.division: Division 3 · Establishing the Maker, exalted is He, His attributes, and His effects

matn.english: It is owed by Him, exalted is He, through inflicting pains, depriving [someone] of benefits for another’s advantage, and inflicting grief, whether it arises from immediate knowledge‎ [العلم الضروري]‎, acquired knowledge‎ [العلم المكتسب]‎ or probable judgment‎ [الظن]‎, but not when it arises from the servant’s own act; and through His commanding His servants to cause harm or permitting it, and enabling nonrational [creatures to cause harm].
matn.arabic: ويستحق عليه تعالى بإنزال الآلام وتفويت المنافع لمصلحة الغير وإنزال الغموم سواء استندت إلى علم ضروري أو مكتسب أو ظن لا ما تستند إلى فعل العبد وأمر عباده بالمضار أو إباحته وتمكين غير العاقل.
matn.division: Division 3 · Establishing the Maker, exalted is He, His attributes, and His effects

matn.english: This differs from burning upon [someone’s] being cast into fire, and killing on the basis of false testimony.
matn.arabic: بخلاف الإحراق عند الإلقاء في النار والقتل عند شهادة الزور.
matn.division: Division 3 · Establishing the Maker, exalted is He, His attributes, and His effects

matn.english: Securing redress‎ [الانتصاف]‎ is obligatory upon Him, exalted is He, by reason‎ [العقل]‎ and transmitted revelation‎ [السمع]‎.
matn.arabic: والانتصاف عليه تعالى واجب عقلا وسمعا. · ‎Āmulī pp. 332, 334⁠–⁠335‎
matn.division: Division 3 · Establishing the Maker, exalted is He, His attributes, and His effects

matn.english: It is therefore impermissible to enable a wrongdoer to inflict wrong without [his already possessing an entitlement to] compensation‎ [العوض]‎ commensurate with his wrongdoing.
matn.arabic: فلا يجوز تمكين الظالم من الظلم من دون عوض في الحال يوازي ظلمه.
matn.division: Division 3 · Establishing the Maker, exalted is He, His attributes, and His effects

matn.english: If the wronged person belongs among the people of Paradise, God, exalted is He, distributes his compensation‎ [العوض]‎ over different times, or graciously grants him its like. If he belongs among those punished, He deducts through it a portion of his punishment‎ [العقاب]‎, so that the alleviation is not apparent to him, by distributing the deducted amount over different times.
matn.arabic: فإن كان المظلوم من أهل الجنة فرق الله تعالى أعواضه على الأوقات أو تفضل عليه بمثلها وإن كان من أهل العقاب أسقط بها جزءا من عقابه بحيث لا يظهر له التخفيف بأن يفرق الناقص على الأوقات. · ‎Āmulī pp. 335⁠–⁠336‎
matn.division: Division 3 · Establishing the Maker, exalted is He, His attributes, and His effects

matn.english: Its permanence is not obligatory: an excess [of benefit] for which the pain would be chosen is good even if it comes to an end. Nor must it occur in this world, since delaying it may serve a benefit. [The claim that] its cessation causes pain is denied; moreover, that lies outside the point at issue.
matn.arabic: ولا يجب دوامه لحسن الزائد بما يختار معه الألم وإن كان منقطعا ولا يجب حصوله في الدنيا لاحتمال مصلحة التأخير والألم علي القطع ممنوع مع أنه غير محل النزاع.
matn.division: Division 3 · Establishing the Maker, exalted is He, His attributes, and His effects

matn.english: It is not obligatory to make its recipient aware that it is being delivered as compensation‎ [العوض]‎.
matn.arabic: ولا يجب إشعار صاحبه بإيصاله عوضا.
matn.division: Division 3 · Establishing the Maker, exalted is He, His attributes, and His effects

matn.english: Its benefits are not confined to any particular [kind].
matn.arabic: ولا يتعين منافعه.
matn.division: Division 3 · Establishing the Maker, exalted is He, His attributes, and His effects

matn.english: It cannot validly be waived.
matn.arabic: ولا يصح إسقاطه. · ‎Āmulī pp. 336⁠–⁠338‎
matn.division: Division 3 · Establishing the Maker, exalted is He, His attributes, and His effects

matn.english: Compensation‎ [العوض]‎ owed by Him, exalted is He, must exceed [the pain] to the point that every rational person would be content [to accept the pain for it]; compensation owed by us must be equal [to the injury].
matn.arabic: والعوض عليه تعالى يجب تزايده إلى حد الرضا عند كل عاقل وعلينا يجب مساواته. · ‎Āmulī pp. 339‎
matn.division: Division 3 · Establishing the Maker, exalted is He, His attributes, and His effects

matn.english: A living creature’s appointed term‎ [الأجل]‎ is the time when its life ends, as known to God Most High.
matn.arabic: وأجل الحيوان الوقت الذي علم الله تعالى بطلان حياته فيه.
matn.division: Division 3 · Establishing the Maker, exalted is He, His attributes, and His effects

matn.english: For someone killed, both [continued life and death] would have been possible had the killing not occurred.
matn.arabic: والمقتول يجوز فيه الأمران لولاه.
matn.division: Division 3 · Establishing the Maker, exalted is He, His attributes, and His effects

matn.english: The appointed term‎ [الأجل]‎ may be gracious assistance‎ [اللطف]‎ for another, but not for the obligated person‎ [المكلف]‎ [whose term it is].
matn.arabic: ويجوز أن يكون الأجل لطفا للغير لا للمكلف. · ‎Āmulī pp. 339⁠–⁠340‎
matn.division: Division 3 · Establishing the Maker, exalted is He, His attributes, and His effects

matn.english: Provision‎ [الرزق]‎ is that from which benefit may legitimately be taken and from which no one is entitled to exclude [the recipient].
matn.arabic: والرزق ما صح الانتفاع به ولم يكن لأحد منعه منه.
matn.division: Division 3 · Establishing the Maker, exalted is He, His attributes, and His effects

matn.english: Striving to obtain it may be obligatory, recommended, permissible or forbidden.
matn.arabic: والسعي في تحصيله قد يجب ويستحب ويباح ويحرم. · ‎Āmulī pp. 341‎
matn.division: Division 3 · Establishing the Maker, exalted is He, His attributes, and His effects

matn.english: Price is the assessment of the countervalue for which something is sold. It is low or high; customary practice and sameness of time and place must be considered. It depends upon Him, exalted is He, and also upon us.
matn.arabic: والسعر تقدير العوض الذي يباع به الشيء وهو رخص وغلاء ولا بد من اعتبار العادة واتحاد الوقت والمكان ويستند إليه تعالى وإلينا أيضا. · ‎Āmulī pp. 342‎
matn.division: Division 3 · Establishing the Maker, exalted is He, His attributes, and His effects

matn.english: What is most beneficial‎ [الأصلح]‎ is obligatory in some circumstances, owing to the presence of the motive‎ [الداعي]‎ and the absence of a dissuading factor.
matn.arabic: والأصلح قد يجب لوجود الداعي وانتفاء الصارف. · ‎Āmulī pp. 343‎
matn.division: Division 3 · Establishing the Maker, exalted is He, His attributes, and His effects

matn.english: The sending of prophets‎ [البعثة]‎ is good because it comprises benefits: reinforcing reason‎ [العقل]‎ in what reason indicates; learning the judgement concerning what reason does not indicate; removing fear; learning what is good and bad, beneficial and harmful; preserving the human species and perfecting its individuals according to their differing dispositions; teaching them recondite crafts, moral character, and the governance of human affairs; and informing them of punishment‎ [العقاب]‎ and reward‎ [الثواب]‎. Thus gracious assistance‎ [اللطف]‎ (luṭf) is provided to the morally responsible person‎ [المكلف]‎.
matn.arabic: البعثة حسنة لاشتمالها على فوائد كمعاضدة العقل فيما يدل عليه واستفادة الحكم فيما لا يدل وإزالة الخوف واستفادة الحسن والقبح والنافع والضار وحفظ النوع الإنساني وتكميل أشخاصه بحسب استعداداتهم المختلفة وتعليمهم الصنائع الخفية والأخلاق والسياسات والإخبار بالعقاب والثواب فيحصل اللطف للمكلف.

matn.english: The Brahmins’ objection is invalidated by what has preceded.
matn.arabic: وشبهة البراهمة باطلة بما تقدم. · ‎Āmulī pp. 344⁠–⁠346, 348‎

matn.english: It is obligatory because it comprises gracious assistance‎ [اللطف]‎ in fulfilling the obligations known by reason.
matn.arabic: وهي واجبة لاشتمالها على اللطف في التكاليف العقلية. · ‎Āmulī pp. 348‎

matn.english: A prophet must be protected from error and sin‎ [العصمة]‎ (ʿiṣma), so that confidence [in him] may be secured and the purpose [of his mission] thereby achieved; also because [without such protection] following him and its contrary would both be obligatory, and it would be obligatory to censure him.
matn.arabic: ويجب في النبي العصمة ليحصل الوثوق فيحصل الغرض ولوجوب متابعته وضدها والإنكار عليه. · ‎Āmulī pp. 349‎

matn.english: [He must also possess] perfection of intellect‎ [العقل]‎, intelligence, discernment, and sound judgement; and freedom from inadvertence and from everything that would repel people from him: baseness of fathers, unchastity of mothers, harshness, coarseness, the condition of desiring receptive anal intercourse (ubna) and similar conditions, eating in the road, and similar conduct.
matn.arabic: وكمال العقل والذكاء والفطنة وقوة الرأي وعدم السهو وكلما ينفر عنه من دناءة الآباء وعهر الأمهات والفظاظة والغلظة والأبنة وشبهها والأكل على الطريق وشبهه. · ‎Āmulī pp. 349‎

matn.english: The way to know his truthfulness‎ [الصدق]‎ is the manifestation of a miracle‎ [المعجزة]‎ at his hand: the occurrence of something uncustomary, or the nonoccurrence of something customary, with a breach of customary order‎ [خرق العادة]‎ and correspondence to the claim.
matn.arabic: وطريق معرفة صدقه ظهور المعجز على يده وهو ثبوت ما ليس بمعتاد أو نفي ما هو معتاد مع خرق العادة ومطابقة الدعوى. · ‎Āmulī pp. 350‎

matn.english: The story of Mary and other such stories establish the possibility‎ [الإمكان]‎ of its manifestation at the hands of the righteous.
matn.arabic: وقصة مريم وغيرها تعطي جواز ظهوره على الصالحين.

matn.english: This does not entail its ceasing to be miraculous, repelling people [from prophets], failure to distinguish [the prophet], invalidation of its evidentiary force, or its universal occurrence [for every truthful person].
matn.arabic: ولا يلزم خروجه عن الإعجاز ولا التنفير ولا عدم التميز ولا إبطال دلالته ولا العمومية.

matn.english: His miracles‎ [المعجزة]‎—peace be upon him—before prophethood‎ [النبوة]‎ establish [the possibility‎ [الإمكان]‎ of] preparatory signs‎ [الإرهاص]‎ (irhāṣ).
matn.arabic: ومعجزاته عليه‌السلام قبل النبوة تعطي الإرهاص.

matn.english: The story of Musaylima and that of Abraham’s Pharaoh establish the possibility‎ [الإمكان]‎ of manifesting a miracle‎ [المعجزة]‎ contrary [to a claimant’s claim].
matn.arabic: وقصة مسيلمة وفرعون إبراهيم تعطي جواز إظهار المعجزة على العكس. · ‎Āmulī pp. 351⁠–⁠353‎

matn.english: The proof of the obligation [to send prophets] establishes its universality [throughout time].
matn.arabic: ودليل الوجوب يعطي العمومية.

matn.english: A revealed law‎ [الشريعة]‎ is not required [for every prophetic mission].
matn.arabic: ولا تجب الشريعة. · ‎Āmulī pp. 353⁠–⁠354‎

matn.english: The manifestation of the miracle‎ [المعجزة]‎ of the Qurʾān and of other miracles, conjoined with the claim of our Prophet Muḥammad—God bless him and his family—indicates his prophethood‎ [النبوة]‎. The challenge, together with failure [to meet it] despite the abundance of motives‎ [الداعي]‎ [to do so], indicates miraculous inimitability‎ [الإعجاز]‎. The miracles transmitted with recurrent agreement in their common import‎ [التواتر المعنوي]‎ (tawātur maʿnawī) reinforce it.
matn.arabic: وظهور معجزة القرآن وغيره مع اقتران دعوة نبينا محمد صلى‌الله‌عليه‌وآله يدل على نبوته. والتحدي مع الامتناع وتوفر الدواعي يدل على الإعجاز. والمنقول معناه متواترا من المعجزات يعضده.

matn.english: The Qurʾān’s miraculous inimitability‎ [الإعجاز]‎ is said to derive from its eloquence; or from its manner of composition together with its eloquence; or from divine prevention‎ [الصرفة]‎ (ṣarfa). All are possible.
matn.arabic: وإعجاز القرآن قيل لفصاحته وقيل لأسلوبه وفصاحته وقيل للصرفة والكل محتمل. · ‎Āmulī pp. 354, 357‎

matn.english: Abrogation‎ [النسخ]‎ follows considerations of benefit.
matn.arabic: والنسخ تابع للمصالح.

matn.english: It has occurred: some things permitted to Noah’s predecessors were forbidden to him; circumcision was made obligatory after its postponement [had been allowed]; marriage to two sisters together was prohibited; and other rulings [were likewise changed].
matn.arabic: وقد وقع حيث حرم على نوح بعض ما أحل لمن تقدمه وأوجب الختان بعد تأخيره وحرم الجمع بين الأختين وغير ذلك من الأحكام.

matn.english: Their report from Moses—peace be upon him—prescribing perpetuity is fabricated; even if it were granted, it would not establish the intended meaning conclusively.
matn.arabic: وخبرهم عن موسى عليه‌السلام بالتأبيد مختلق ومع تسليمه لا يدل على المراد قطعا. · ‎Āmulī pp. 357⁠–⁠358‎

matn.english: Transmitted revelation‎ [السمع]‎ indicates the universality of his prophethood‎ [النبوة]‎—God bless him and his family and grant them peace.
matn.arabic: والسمع دل على عموم نبوته صلى‌الله‌عليه‌وآله‌وسلم.

matn.english: He is superior to the angels, as are the other prophets—peace be upon them—because [within them] there is something opposed to the rational faculty, and they compel it to obey that faculty.
matn.arabic: وهو أفضل من الملائكة وكذا غيره من الأنبياء عليه‌السلام لوجود المضاد للقوة العقلية وقهره على الانقياد عليها. · ‎Āmulī pp. 359⁠–⁠360‎

matn.english: The imam is gracious assistance‎ [اللطف]‎ (luṭf); therefore God Most High is obliged to appoint him, so that the purpose [of moral obligation]‎ [التكليف]‎ may be achieved.
matn.arabic: الإمام لطف فيجب نصبه على الله تعالى تحصيلا للغرض.

matn.english: The absence of harmful consequences is known, and rational persons know that this gracious assistance‎ [اللطف]‎ is confined to him. His existence‎ [الوجود]‎ is gracious assistance, and his exercise of authority is another; its absence is due to us.
matn.arabic: والمفاسد معلومة الانتفاء وانحصار اللطف فيه معلوم للعقلاء ووجوده لطف وتصرفه آخر وعدمه منا. · ‎Āmulī pp. 360⁠–⁠362‎

matn.english: The impossibility of an infinite regress‎ [التسلسل]‎ requires his protection from error and sin‎ [العصمة]‎. [This is also required] because he preserves the revealed law‎ [الشريعة]‎; because, if he committed a sin, censuring him would be obligatory, contradicting the command to obey him and defeating the purpose of his appointment; and because [otherwise] his rank would fall below that of the least of the common people.
matn.arabic: وامتناع التسلسل يوجب عصمته ولأنه حافظ للشرع ولوجوب الإنكار عليه لو أقدم على المعصية فيضاد أمر الطاعة ويفوت الغرض من نصبه ولانحطاط درجته عن أقل العوام.

matn.english: Protection from error and sin‎ [العصمة]‎ does not conflict with power‎ [القدرة]‎ [to commit sin].
matn.arabic: ولا تنافي العصمة القدرة. · ‎Āmulī pp. 364⁠–⁠365‎

matn.english: The badness‎ [القبح]‎ of giving precedence to the inferior is known; and, where [candidates] are equal, there is no ground of preference.
matn.arabic: وقبح تقديم المفضول معلوم ولا ترجيح في المساوي

matn.english: Protection from error and sin‎ [العصمة]‎ requires explicit designation‎ [النص]‎, as does the conduct of [the Prophet]—peace be upon him.
matn.arabic: والعصمة تقتضي النص وسيرته عليه‌السلام. · ‎Āmulī pp. 366‎

matn.english: Both [protection from error and sin‎ [العصمة]‎ and explicit designation]‎ [النص]‎ belong uniquely to ʿAlī—peace be upon him.
matn.arabic: وهما مختصان بعلي عليه‌السلام.

matn.english: [There is] the unambiguous designation‎ [النص الجلي]‎ in his sayings, ‘Greet him as Commander of the Faithful’, ‘You are the successor after me’, and others.
matn.arabic: والنص الجلي في قوله سلموا عليه بإمرة المؤمنين وأنت الخليفة من بعدي وغيرهما.

matn.english: Also His—Most High—saying, ‘Your guardian is only God and His Messenger’, to the end of the verse; the attributes [mentioned there] are found together only in ʿAlī—peace be upon him.
matn.arabic: ولقوله تعالى (إِنَّما وَلِيُّكُمُ اللهُ وَرَسُولُهُ) الآية وإنما اجتمعت الأوصاف في علي عليه‌السلام.

matn.english: Also the recurrently transmitted‎ [المتواتر]‎ report of Ghadīr.
matn.arabic: ولحديث الغدير المتواتر.

matn.english: Also the recurrently transmitted‎ [المتواتر]‎ report of the Station [of Aaron].
matn.arabic: ولحديث المنزلة المتواتر. · ‎Āmulī pp. 367⁠–⁠369‎

matn.english: Also his appointing him as deputy over Medina, which extends generally by consensus‎ [الإجماع]‎.
matn.arabic: ولاستخلافه على المدينة فيعم للإجماع.

matn.english: Also his saying—peace be upon him—“You are my brother, my legatee, my successor after me, and the adjudicator of [matters of] my religion”—with a kasra on the dāl [of dīnī].
matn.arabic: ولقوله عليه‌السلام أنت أخي ووصيي وخليفتي من بعدي وقاضي ديني بكسر الدال.

matn.english: Also because he is superior, and the imamate‎ [الإمامة]‎ of an inferior person is rationally bad.
matn.arabic: ولأنه أفضل وإمامة المفضول قبيحة عقلا.

matn.english: Also because miracles‎ [المعجزة]‎ appeared at his hand: uprooting the gate of Khaybar, conversing with the serpent, lifting the immense rock from the well, fighting the jinn, bringing back the sun, and others. He claimed the imamate‎ [الإمامة]‎; therefore he was truthful.
matn.arabic: ولظهور المعجزة على يده كقلع باب خيبر ومخاطبة الثعبان ورفع الصخرة العظيمة عن القليب ومحاربة الجن ورد الشمس وغير ذلك وادعى الإمامة فيكون صادقا. · ‎Āmulī pp. 369⁠–⁠370‎

matn.english: Also because the others’ prior unbelief‎ [الكفر]‎ disqualifies them for the imamate‎ [الإمامة]‎, leaving him—peace be upon him—as the one determined [for it].
matn.arabic: ولسبق كفر غيره فلا يصلح للإمامة فتعين هو عليه‌السلام.

matn.english: Also His—Most High—saying, ‘Be with the truthful.’
matn.arabic: ولقوله تعالى (وَكُونُوا مَعَ الصَّادِقِينَ).

matn.english: Also His—Most High—saying, ‘And those vested with authority among you.’
matn.arabic: ولقوله تعالى (وَأُولِي الْأَمْرِ مِنْكُمْ). · ‎Āmulī pp. 371‎

matn.english: For the group apart from ʿAlī—peace be upon him—are unfit for the imamate‎ [الإمامة]‎, on account of their wrongdoing through their prior unbelief‎ [الكفر]‎.
matn.arabic: ولأن الجماعة غير علي عليه‌السلام غير صالح للإمامة لظلمهم بتقدم كفرهم. · ‎Āmulī pp. 372‎

matn.english: Abū Bakr contradicted the Book of God Most High by preventing inheritance from God’s Messenger—God bless him and his family—on the basis of a report that he himself related.
matn.arabic: وخالف أبو بكر كتاب الله تعالى في منع إرث رسول الله صلى‌الله‌عليه‌وآله بخبر رواه هو.

matn.english: He withheld Fadak from Fāṭima—peace be upon her—despite her claim that it had been given to her as a gift and the testimony of ʿAlī—peace be upon him—and Umm Ayman; yet he accepted the wives’ claims that their rooms belonged to them. For this reason ʿUmar ibn ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz restored it.
matn.arabic: ومنع فاطمة عليها‌السلام فدكا مع ادعاء النحلة لها وشهد علي عليه‌السلام وأم أيمن وصدق الأزواج في ادعاء الحجرة لهن ولهذا ردها عمر بن عبد العزيز.

matn.english: She instructed that Abū Bakr should not perform the funeral prayer over her; she was therefore buried at night.
matn.arabic: وأوصت أن لا يصلي عليها أبو بكر فدفنت ليلا. · ‎Āmulī pp. 372⁠–⁠373‎

matn.english: Also because of his saying, ‘Release me [from office], for I am not the best of you while ʿAlī is among you.’
matn.arabic: ولقوله أقيلوني فلست بخيركم وعلي فيكم.

matn.english: Also because of his saying that a devil sometimes overtakes him.
matn.arabic: ولقوله إن له شيطانا يعتريه

matn.english: Also because of ʿUmar’s saying, ‘The pledge to Abū Bakr was an unpremeditated occurrence whose evil God averted; whoever returns to anything like it, kill him.’
matn.arabic: ولقول عمر كانت بيعة أبي بكر فلتة وقى الله شرها فمن عاد إلى مثلها فاقتلوه.

matn.english: At his death he doubted his entitlement to the imamate‎ [الإمامة]‎.
matn.arabic: وشك عند موته في استحقاقه للإمامة

matn.english: He contradicted the Messenger—God bless him and his family—by appointing a successor, according to their own account, and by appointing someone whom he—God bless him and his family—had dismissed.
matn.arabic: وخالف الرسول صلى‌الله‌عليه‌وآله في الاستخلاف عندهم وفي تولية من عزله صلى‌الله‌عليه‌وآله. · ‎Āmulī pp. 373⁠–⁠374‎

matn.english: [He also contradicted him] by staying behind from Usāma’s army, although they knew the intention was to send them away. [The Prophet] appointed Usāma over them, so Usāma is superior [to them]; whereas no one was appointed over ʿAlī—peace be upon him—and he is superior to Usāma.
matn.arabic: وفي التخلف عن جيش أسامة مع علمهم بقصد البعد وولى أسامة عليهم فهو أفضل وعلي عليه‌السلام لم يول عليه أحدا وهو أفضل من أسامة.

matn.english: He held no office during his [the Prophet’s] lifetime. [The Prophet] gave him Sūrat Barāʾa, but Gabriel descended and instructed [the Prophet] to recall him and take the sūra from him, and that no one should recite it except himself or someone of his household. He therefore sent ʿAlī—peace be upon him—with it.
matn.arabic: ولم يتول عملا في زمانه وأعطاه سورة براءة فنزل جبرئيل فأمره برده وأخذ السورة منه وأن لا يقرأها إلا هو أو أحد من أهل بيته فبعث بها عليا عليه‌السلام. · ‎Āmulī pp. 375‎

matn.english: He did not know the legal rulings: he cut off a thief’s left hand and burned [a man] with fire; he did not know [the ruling on] collateral inheritance (kalāla) or the grandmother’s inheritance; his rulings were inconsistent; and he neither imposed the prescribed penalty on Khālid nor exacted retaliation from him.
matn.arabic: ولم يكن عارفا بالأحكام حتى قطع يسار سارق وأحرق بالنار ولم يعرف الكلالة ولا ميراث الجدة واضطرب في أحكامه ولم يحد خالدا ولا اقتص منه. · ‎Āmulī pp. 376‎

matn.english: He was buried in the house of God’s Messenger—God bless him and his family—although God Most High had prohibited entering it without permission during his lifetime. He sent [men] to the house of the Commander of the Faithful—peace be upon him—when he refused the pledge, and had it set on fire while Fāṭima, al-Ḥasan, al-Ḥusayn, and a group of the Banū Hāshim were inside. Al-Ḥasan and al-Ḥusayn objected to him when allegiance was pledged to him; and he regretted violating the house of Fāṭima—peace be upon her.
matn.arabic: ودفن في بيت رسول الله صلى‌الله‌عليه‌وآله وقد نهى الله تعالى دخوله في حياته بغير إذن وبعث إلى بيت أمير المؤمنين عليه‌السلام لما امتنع من البيعة فأضرم فيه النار وفيه فاطمة والحسن والحسين وجماعة من بني هاشم ورد عليه الحسنان لما بويع وندم على كشف بيت فاطمة عليها‌السلام. · ‎Āmulī pp. 376‎

matn.english: ʿUmar ordered the stoning of a pregnant woman and of another woman who was insane. ʿAlī—peace be upon him—prevented him, and he said, ‘Were it not for ʿAlī, ʿUmar would have perished.’
matn.arabic: وأمر عمر برجم امرأة حامل وأخرى مجنونة فنهاه علي عليه‌السلام فقال لو لا علي لهلك عمر.

matn.english: He doubted the Prophet’s death—God bless him and his family and grant them peace—until Abū Bakr recited to him, ‘You shall die, and they shall die.’ He then said, ‘It is as though I had never heard this verse.’
matn.arabic: وتشكك في موت النبي صلى‌الله‌عليه‌وآله‌وسلم حتى تلا عليه أبو بكر : إنك ميت وإنهم ميتون فقال كأني لم أسمع هذه الآية.

matn.english: He said, ‘Everyone understands the law better than ʿUmar, even secluded women’, when he prohibited excessive marriage payments.
matn.arabic: وقال كل أفقه من عمر حتى المخدرات لما منع من المغالاة في الصداق. · ‎Āmulī pp. 377⁠–⁠378‎

matn.english: He gave [public funds] to the Prophet’s wives—God bless him and his family and grant them peace—borrowed [from those funds], and withheld from the People of the House—peace be upon them—their fifth.
matn.arabic: وأعطى أزواج النبي صلى‌الله‌عليه‌وآله‌وسلم واقترض ومنع أهل البيت عليهم‌السلام من خمسهم.

matn.english: He issued a hundred rulings concerning [inheritance by] the grandfather, favoured some over others in distributions, and prohibited the two mutʿas.
matn.arabic: وقضى في الجد مائة قضية وفضل في القسمة ومنع المتعتين :

matn.english: He decided the arrangements for the consultative council contrary to what was correct.
matn.arabic: وحكم في الشورى بضد الصواب.

matn.english: He tore up Fāṭima’s document—peace be upon her.
matn.arabic: وخرق كتاب فاطمة عليها‌السلام. · ‎Āmulī pp. 378⁠–⁠379‎

matn.english: ʿUthmān appointed men whose transgression‎ [الفسق]‎ was evident, so that they introduced into Muslim affairs the innovations they introduced.
matn.arabic: وولى عثمان من ظهر فسقه حتى أحدثوا في أمر المسلمين ما أحدثوا.

matn.english: He preferred his relatives in the allocation of wealth.
matn.arabic: وآثر أهله بالأموال.

matn.english: He reserved grazing land for himself.
matn.arabic: وحمى لنفسه.

matn.english: He committed reprehensible acts against the Companions: he beat Ibn Masʿūd until he died and burned his copy of the Qurʾān; he beat ʿAmmār until he suffered a hernia; and he beat Abū Dharr and exiled him to al-Rabadha.
matn.arabic: ووقع منه أشياء منكرة في حق الصحابة فضرب ابن مسعود حتى مات وأحرق مصحفه وضرب عمارا حتى أصابه فتق وضرب أبا ذر ونفاه إلى الربذة.

matn.english: He waived retaliation against Ibn ʿUmar and the prescribed penalty against al-Walīd, although both were obligatory.
matn.arabic: وأسقط القود عن ابن عمر والحد عن الوليد مع وجوبهما. · ‎Āmulī pp. 379⁠–⁠380‎

matn.english: The Companions abandoned him until he was killed. The Commander of the Faithful—peace be upon him—said, ‘God killed him.’ He was not buried until three days later, and they censured his absence from Badr, Uḥud, and the pledge [of al-Riḍwān].
matn.arabic: وخذله الصحابة حتى قتل وقال أمير المؤمنين عليه‌السلام : الله قتله. ولم يدفن إلا بعد ثلاثة أيام وعابوا غيبته عن بدر وأحد والبيعة. · ‎Āmulī pp. 381‎

matn.english: ʿAlī—peace be upon him—is superior because of his extensive striving in battle and his outstanding service in all the campaigns of the Prophet—God bless him and his family and grant them peace. No one attained his rank at Badr, Uḥud, the Day of the Confederates, Khaybar, Ḥunayn, and the other campaigns.
matn.arabic: وعلي عليه‌السلام أفضل لكثرة جهاده وعظم بلائه في وقائع النبي صلى‌الله‌عليه‌وآله‌وسلم بأجمعها ولم يبلغ أحد درجته في غزاة بدر وأحد ويوم الأحزاب وخيبر وحنين وغيرها. · ‎Āmulī pp. 381‎

matn.english: Also because he is the most knowledgeable, owing to the strength‎ [القوة]‎ of his immediate insight and his close, constant attendance on the Messenger—God bless him and his family and grant them peace. The Companions referred to him in most cases after making mistakes. The Prophet—God bless him and his family and grant them peace—said, ‘The best judge among you is ʿAlī.’ The eminent masters of all the sciences traced their learning back to him, and he—peace be upon him—himself declared this.
matn.arabic: ولأنه أعلم لقوة حدسه وشدة ملازمته للرسول صلى‌الله‌عليه‌وآله‌وسلم ورجعت الصحابة إليه في أكثر الوقائع بعد غلطهم وقال النبي صلى‌الله‌عليه‌وآله‌وسلم أقضاكم علي واستند الفضلاء في جميع العلوم إليه وأخبر هو عليه‌السلام بذلك.

matn.english: Also His—Most High—saying, ‘And ourselves.’
matn.arabic: ولقوله تعالى (وَأَنْفُسَنا).

matn.english: Also because his generosity exceeded that of others.
matn.arabic: ولكثرة سخائه على غيره. · ‎Āmulī pp. 383, 385‎

matn.english: He was the most ascetic of people after the Prophet—God bless him and his family and grant them peace.
matn.arabic: وكان أزهد الناس بعد النبي صلى‌الله‌عليه‌وآله‌وسلم.

matn.english: And the most devoted in worship.
matn.arabic: وأعبدهم.

matn.english: And the most forbearing.
matn.arabic: وأحلمهم.

matn.english: And the noblest in character.
matn.arabic: وأشرفهم خلقا.

matn.english: And the earliest in faith‎ [الإيمان]‎.
matn.arabic: وأقدمهم إيمانا. · ‎Āmulī pp. 386⁠–⁠388‎

matn.english: And the most eloquent.
matn.arabic: وأفصحهم.

matn.english: And the soundest in judgement.
matn.arabic: وأسدهم رأيا.

matn.english: And the most zealous to uphold the limits prescribed by God Most High.
matn.arabic: وأكثرهم حرصا على إقامة حدود الله تعالى.

matn.english: And the most accomplished in memorising the Mighty Book.
matn.arabic: وأحفظهم للكتاب العزيز.

matn.english: Also because of his reports of the unseen.
matn.arabic: ولإخباره بالغيب. · ‎Āmulī pp. 389⁠–⁠390‎

matn.english: And the answering of his supplication.
matn.arabic: واستجابة دعائه.

matn.english: And the miracles‎ [المعجزة]‎ manifested through him.
matn.arabic: وظهور المعجزات عنه.

matn.english: And his distinctive kinship [with the Prophet].
matn.arabic: واختصاصه بالقرابة.

matn.english: And brotherhood [with him].
matn.arabic: والأخوة.

matn.english: And the obligation to love [him].
matn.arabic: ووجوب المحبة. · ‎Āmulī pp. 391⁠–⁠392‎

matn.english: And his support [of the Messenger].
matn.arabic: والنصرة.

matn.english: And his equality with the prophets.
matn.arabic: ومساواة الأنبياء.

matn.english: And the reports of the Bird, the Station [of Aaron], Ghadīr, and others.
matn.arabic: وخبر الطائر والمنزلة والغدير وغيرها.

matn.english: Also because no unbelief‎ [الكفر]‎ preceded [his faith]‎ [الإيمان]‎.
matn.arabic: ولانتفاء سبق كفره.

matn.english: Also because of the abundance of benefit derived from him.
matn.arabic: ولكثرة الانتفاع به. · ‎Āmulī pp. 392⁠–⁠393, 395‎

matn.english: And his distinction in perfections of soul‎ [النفس]‎, body, and external circumstances.
matn.arabic: وتميزه بالكمالات النفسانية والبدنية والخارجية. · ‎Āmulī pp. 395‎

matn.english: Recurrently transmitted‎ [المتواتر]‎ reports indicate [the imamate‎ [الإمامة]‎ of] the eleven; also [it follows] from the necessity‎ [الوجوب]‎ of protection from error and sin‎ [العصمة]‎, its absence in others, and the presence of perfections in them.
matn.arabic: والنقل المتواتر دل على الأحد عشر ولوجوب العصمة وانتفائها عن غيرهم ووجود الكمالات فيهم. · ‎Āmulī pp. 397‎

matn.english: Those who wage war against ʿAlī—peace be upon him—are unbelievers; those who oppose him [in the imamate]‎ [الإمامة]‎ are transgressors.
matn.arabic: ومحاربو علي عليه‌السلام كفرة ومخالفوه فسقة. · ‎Āmulī pp. 398‎

matn.english: The same judgement applies to two things that are alike; transmitted revelation‎ [السمع]‎ indicates the possibility‎ [الإمكان]‎ of a counterpart [to this world].
matn.arabic: حكم المثلين واحد والسمع دل على إمكان المماثل
matn.division: Division 6 · The return, the promise, the threat, and related matters
matn.chapter: Division 6 · The return, the promise, the threat, and related matters

matn.english: Sphericity [as a necessary feature of another world], the necessity‎ [الوجوب]‎ of a void, and a divergence between things alike [in nature] are not conceded.
matn.arabic: والكرية ووجوب الخلاء واختلاف المتفقات ممنوعة. · ‎Āmulī pp. 398⁠–⁠400‎
matn.division: Division 6 · The return, the promise, the threat, and related matters
matn.chapter: Division 6 · The return, the promise, the threat, and related matters

matn.english: Contingency‎ [الإمكان]‎ allows nonexistence‎ [العدم]‎ [of the world].
matn.arabic: والإمكان يعطي جواز العدم.
matn.division: Division 6 · The return, the promise, the threat, and related matters
matn.chapter: Division 6 · The return, the promise, the threat, and related matters

matn.english: Transmitted revelation‎ [السمع]‎ indicates its [actual] occurrence.
matn.arabic: والسمع دل عليه.
matn.division: Division 6 · The return, the promise, the threat, and related matters
matn.chapter: Division 6 · The return, the promise, the threat, and related matters

matn.english: For the morally responsible person‎ [المكلف]‎, this is interpreted as the dispersal [of bodily parts], as in the story of Abraham—peace be upon him.
matn.arabic: ويتأول في المكلف بالتفريق كما في قصة إبراهيم عليه‌السلام. · ‎Āmulī pp. 401⁠–⁠402‎
matn.division: Division 6 · The return, the promise, the threat, and related matters
matn.chapter: Division 6 · The return, the promise, the threat, and related matters

matn.english: Positing annihilation‎ [الفناء]‎ [as a distinct existent] is unintelligible: if it subsisted by itself it would not be a contrary [to substance]‎ [الجوهر]‎; and the same is true if it subsisted in a substance.
matn.arabic: وإثبات الفناء غير معقول لأنه إن قام بذاته لم يكن ضدا وكذا إن قام بالجوهر.
matn.division: Division 6 · The return, the promise, the threat, and related matters
matn.chapter: Division 6 · The return, the promise, the threat, and related matters

matn.english: Also because there is no ground of priority [for its annihilating the substance‎ [الجوهر]‎ rather than the substance excluding it].
matn.arabic: ولانتفاء الأولوية.
matn.division: Division 6 · The return, the promise, the threat, and related matters
matn.chapter: Division 6 · The return, the promise, the threat, and related matters

matn.english: Also because it entails either a reversal of essential natures or an infinite regress‎ [التسلسل]‎.
matn.arabic: ولاستلزامه انقلاب الحقائق أو التسلسل. · ‎Āmulī pp. 403⁠–⁠404‎
matn.division: Division 6 · The return, the promise, the threat, and related matters
matn.chapter: Division 6 · The return, the promise, the threat, and related matters

matn.english: Positing persistence‎ [البقاء]‎ (baqāʾ) outside a substrate‎ [المحل]‎ entails either preference without a determining ground or the conjunction of contradictories.
matn.arabic: وإثبات بقاء لا في محل يستلزم الترجيح من غير مرجح أو اجتماع النقيضين.
matn.division: Division 6 · The return, the promise, the threat, and related matters
matn.chapter: Division 6 · The return, the promise, the threat, and related matters

matn.english: Positing it within a substrate‎ [المحل]‎ entails a thing’s dependence on itself, either immediately or through an intermediary.
matn.arabic: وإثباته في المحل يستلزم توقف الشيء على نفسه إما ابتداء أو بواسطة. · ‎Āmulī pp. 404⁠–⁠405‎
matn.division: Division 6 · The return, the promise, the threat, and related matters
matn.chapter: Division 6 · The return, the promise, the threat, and related matters

matn.english: The obligation to fulfil the promise, and wisdom‎ [الحكمة]‎, require resurrection‎ [البعث]‎. It is known without inference‎ [الضرورة]‎ that bodily [resurrection]‎ [المعاد الجسماني]‎ belongs to the religion of the Prophet—God bless him and his family and grant them peace—and it is possible.
matn.arabic: ووجوب إيفاء الوعد والحكمة يقتضي وجوب البعث والضرورة قاضية بثبوت الجسماني من دين النبي صلى‌الله‌عليه‌وآله‌وسلم مع إمكانه.
matn.division: Division 6 · The return, the promise, the threat, and related matters
matn.chapter: Division 6 · The return, the promise, the threat, and related matters

matn.english: It is not necessary to restore the morally responsible person‎ [المكلف]‎’s superadded [bodily] parts.
matn.arabic: ولا تجب إعادة فواضل المكلف.
matn.division: Division 6 · The return, the promise, the threat, and related matters
matn.chapter: Division 6 · The return, the promise, the threat, and related matters

matn.english: [Arguments from] the claim that the celestial spheres cannot be ruptured, Paradise’s being above them, the persistence of life during burning, the generation of the body without procreation, and the finitude of bodily capacities‎ [القوى الجسمانية]‎ are merely appeals to improbability.
matn.arabic: وعدم انخراق الأفلاك وحصول الجنة فوقها ودوام الحياة مع الاحتراق وتولد البدن من غير التوالد وتناهي القوى الجسمانية استبعادات. · ‎Āmulī pp. 405⁠–⁠407‎
matn.division: Division 6 · The return, the promise, the threat, and related matters
matn.chapter: Division 6 · The return, the promise, the threat, and related matters

matn.english: Reward‎ [الثواب]‎ and praise are deserved for performing the obligatory and the recommended, performing the contrary of what is bad, and omitting the bad—provided that the obligatory is done because it is obligatory or because of the ground of its obligatoriness; the recommended likewise; the contrary [of the bad] because it is abstention from the bad; and its omission because it is such an omission. For hardship without compensation‎ [العوض]‎ is injustice‎ [الظلم]‎; and, if [the benefit] could be bestowed initially [without the obligation], [imposing the obligation] would be purposeless.
matn.arabic: ويستحق الثواب والمدح بفعل الواجب والمندوب وفعل ضد القبيح والإخلال به بشرط فعل الواجب لوجوبه أو لوجه وجوبه والمندوب كذلك والضد لأنه ترك القبيح والإخلال به لأنه إخلال به لأن المشقة من غير عوض ظلم ولو أمكن الابتداء به كان عبثا. · ‎Āmulī pp. 407⁠–⁠408‎
matn.division: Division 6 · The return, the promise, the threat, and related matters
matn.chapter: Division 6 · The return, the promise, the threat, and related matters

matn.english: Likewise punishment‎ [العقاب]‎ and blame are deserved for doing what is bad and omitting what is obligatory, because [the prospect of punishment] provides gracious assistance‎ [اللطف]‎ and because of transmitted revelation‎ [السمع]‎.
matn.arabic: وكذا يستحق العقاب والذم بفعل القبيح والإخلال بالواجب لاشتماله على اللطف وللسمع.
matn.division: Division 6 · The return, the promise, the threat, and related matters
matn.chapter: Division 6 · The return, the promise, the threat, and related matters

matn.english: There is nothing improbable in simultaneously deserving [praise and blame] in different respects.
matn.arabic: ولا استبعاد في اجتماع الاستحقاقين باعتبارين.
matn.division: Division 6 · The return, the promise, the threat, and related matters
matn.chapter: Division 6 · The return, the promise, the threat, and related matters

matn.english: Imposing hardship as gratitude for a benefit is bad.
matn.arabic: وإيجاب المشقة في شكر النعمة قبيح.
matn.division: Division 6 · The return, the promise, the threat, and related matters
matn.chapter: Division 6 · The return, the promise, the threat, and related matters

matn.english: Also because reason‎ [العقل]‎ judges it [gratitude] obligatory despite ignorance [of revealed obligations].
matn.arabic: ولقضاء العقل به مع الجهل. · ‎Āmulī pp. 408⁠–⁠409‎
matn.division: Division 6 · The return, the promise, the threat, and related matters
matn.chapter: Division 6 · The return, the promise, the threat, and related matters

matn.english: Deserving reward‎ [الثواب]‎ requires that the act or omission be difficult; it does not require the absence of regret for having performed it, nor the absence of immediate benefit, if it was performed for the relevant ground.
matn.arabic: ويشترط في استحقاق الثواب كون الفعل أو الإخلال به شاقا لا رفع الندم على فعله ولا انتفاء النفع العاجل إذا فعل للوجه. · ‎Āmulī pp. 410‎
matn.division: Division 6 · The return, the promise, the threat, and related matters
matn.chapter: Division 6 · The return, the promise, the threat, and related matters

matn.english: Reward‎ [الثواب]‎ must be accompanied by honour, and punishment‎ [العقاب]‎ by humiliation, because it is known without inference‎ [العلم الضروري]‎ that both are deserved when the acts that warrant them are performed.
matn.arabic: ويجب اقتران الثواب بالتعظيم والعقاب بالإهانة للعلم الضروري باستحقاقهما مع فعل موجبهما.
matn.division: Division 6 · The return, the promise, the threat, and related matters
matn.chapter: Division 6 · The return, the promise, the threat, and related matters

matn.english: Both must endure perpetually, because this provides gracious assistance‎ [اللطف]‎, because praise and blame endure, and because their opposites would occur without it.
matn.arabic: ويجب دوامهما لاشتماله على اللطفية ولدوام المدح والذم ولحصول نقيضهما لولاه.
matn.division: Division 6 · The return, the promise, the threat, and related matters
matn.chapter: Division 6 · The return, the promise, the threat, and related matters

matn.english: Both must be unmixed [with their opposites]. Otherwise reward‎ [الثواب]‎ would be inferior to compensation‎ [العوض]‎ and gratuitous favour‎ [التفضل]‎, supposing such purity in those two; and [unmixed punishment]‎ [العقاب]‎ is more effective as a deterrent.
matn.arabic: ويجب خلوصهما وإلا لكان الثواب أنقص حالا من العوض والتفضل على تقدير حصوله فيهما وهو أدخل في باب الزجر. · ‎Āmulī pp. 410⁠–⁠411‎
matn.division: Division 6 · The return, the promise, the threat, and related matters
matn.chapter: Division 6 · The return, the promise, the threat, and related matters

matn.english: Everyone who has a rank in Paradise desires no higher one. Their delight in gratitude reaches the point at which hardship disappears; their reward‎ [الثواب]‎ frees them from need and thus removes the difficulty of abstaining from bad acts. The people of the Fire are compelled to refrain from the bad.
matn.arabic: وكل ذي مرتبة في الجنة لا يطلب الأزيد ويبلغ سرورهم بالشكر إلى حد انتفاء المشقة وغنائهم بالثواب ينفي مشقة ترك القبائح وأهل النار يلجئون إلى ترك القبيح. · ‎Āmulī pp. 411‎
matn.division: Division 6 · The return, the promise, the threat, and related matters
matn.chapter: Division 6 · The return, the promise, the threat, and related matters
