matn.english: Reward‎ [الثواب]‎ may depend on a condition; otherwise the person who knows only God Most High would be rewarded [without accepting His messenger].
matn.arabic: ويجوز توقف الثواب على شرط وإلا لأثيب العارف بالله تعالى خاصة.
matn.division: Division 6 · The return, the promise, the threat, and related matters
matn.chapter: Division 6 · The return, the promise, the threat, and related matters

matn.english: It is conditioned on final perseverance‎ [الموافاة]‎ (muwāfāt), because of His—Most High—saying, ‘If you associate partners [with God], your work will surely be nullified’, and His saying, ‘Whoever among you turns back from his religion’.
matn.arabic: وهو مشروط بالموافاة لقوله تعالى : (لَئِنْ أَشْرَكْتَ لَيَحْبَطَنَّ عَمَلُكَ) وقوله تعالى (وَمَنْ يَرْتَدِدْ مِنْكُمْ عَنْ دِينِهِ) · ‎Āmulī pp. 412‎
matn.division: Division 6 · The return, the promise, the threat, and related matters
matn.chapter: Division 6 · The return, the promise, the threat, and related matters

matn.english: Nullification‎ [الإحباط]‎ [of reward‎ [الثواب]‎ by subsequent sin] is false, because it entails injustice‎ [الظلم]‎, and because of His—Most High—saying, ‘Whoever does an atom’s weight of good will see it.’
matn.arabic: والإحباط باطل لاستلزامه الظلم ولقوله تعالى (فَمَنْ يَعْمَلْ مِثْقالَ ذَرَّةٍ خَيْراً يَرَهُ).
matn.division: Division 6 · The return, the promise, the threat, and related matters
matn.chapter: Division 6 · The return, the promise, the threat, and related matters

matn.english: Also because there is no ground of priority when one is twice the other, and because contradictories result when they are equal.
matn.arabic: ولعدم الأولوية إذا كان الآخر ضعفا وحصول المتناقضين مع التساوي. · ‎Āmulī pp. 413‎
matn.division: Division 6 · The return, the promise, the threat, and related matters
matn.chapter: Division 6 · The return, the promise, the threat, and related matters

matn.english: The unbeliever remains forever [in punishment]‎ [العقاب]‎; the punishment of the perpetrator of a grave sin‎ [الكبيرة]‎ comes to an end, because he deserves reward‎ [الثواب]‎ through his faith‎ [الإيمان]‎, and because [endless punishment in his case] is bad in the judgement of rational persons.
matn.arabic: والكافر مخلد وعذاب صاحب الكبيرة منقطع لاستحقاقه الثواب بإيمانه ولقبحه عند العقلاء.
matn.division: Division 6 · The return, the promise, the threat, and related matters
matn.chapter: Division 6 · The return, the promise, the threat, and related matters

matn.english: The transmitted texts‎ [السمعيات]‎ [cited against this] are subject to interpretation; perpetual punishment‎ [العقاب]‎ belongs exclusively to the unbeliever.
matn.arabic: والسمعيات متأولة ودوام العقاب مختص بالكافر. · ‎Āmulī pp. 414⁠–⁠415‎
matn.division: Division 6 · The return, the promise, the threat, and related matters
matn.chapter: Division 6 · The return, the promise, the threat, and related matters

matn.english: Pardon‎ [العفو]‎ occurs. For [punishment]‎ [العقاب]‎ is His—Most High—right and may therefore be waived; abandoning it causes Him no harm, while it harms the one on whom it descends, so waiving it is good; and it is an act of beneficence‎ [الإحسان]‎.
matn.arabic: والعفو واقع لأنه حقه تعالى فجاز إسقاطه ولا ضرر عليه في تركه مع ضرر النازل به فحسن إسقاطه ولأنه إحسان.
matn.division: Division 6 · The return, the promise, the threat, and related matters
matn.chapter: Division 6 · The return, the promise, the threat, and related matters

matn.english: Also because of transmitted revelation‎ [السمع]‎.
matn.arabic: وللسمع. · ‎Āmulī pp. 415⁠–⁠416‎
matn.division: Division 6 · The return, the promise, the threat, and related matters
matn.chapter: Division 6 · The return, the promise, the threat, and related matters

matn.english: There is consensus‎ [الإجماع]‎ concerning intercession‎ [الشفاعة]‎. It has been said to consist in increasing benefits, but [confining it to this] is refuted by our [prayers] on his behalf—God bless him and his family and grant them peace.
matn.arabic: والإجماع على الشفاعة فقيل لزيادة المنافع ويبطل بنا في حقه صلى‌الله‌عليه‌وآله‌وسلم.
matn.division: Division 6 · The return, the promise, the threat, and related matters
matn.chapter: Division 6 · The return, the promise, the threat, and related matters

matn.english: Denying an [intercessor] who is obeyed does not entail denying one whose petition is answered. The remaining transmitted texts‎ [السمعيات]‎ [of denial] are interpreted as concerning unbelievers.
matn.arabic: ونفي المطاع لا يستلزم نفي المجاب وباقي السمعيات متأولة بالكفار. · ‎Āmulī pp. 416‎
matn.division: Division 6 · The return, the promise, the threat, and related matters
matn.chapter: Division 6 · The return, the promise, the threat, and related matters

matn.english: It has also been said to consist in removing harms. The truth is that ‘intercession‎ [الشفاعة]‎’ applies to both, and that the second is established for him—God bless him and his family and grant them peace—by his saying, ‘I have reserved my intercession for the perpetrators of grave sins‎ [الكبيرة]‎ among my community.’
matn.arabic: وقيل في إسقاط المضار والحق صدق الشفاعة فيهما وثبوت الثاني له صلى‌الله‌عليه‌وآله‌وسلم بقوله ادخرت شفاعتي لأهل الكبائر من أمتي. · ‎Āmulī pp. 417‎
matn.division: Division 6 · The return, the promise, the threat, and related matters
matn.chapter: Division 6 · The return, the promise, the threat, and related matters

matn.english: Repentance‎ [التوبة]‎ is obligatory because it averts harm, and because remorse for every bad act or omission of an obligation is obligatory.
matn.arabic: والتوبة واجبة لدفعها الضرر ولوجوب الندم على كل قبيح أو إخلال بواجب.
matn.division: Division 6 · The return, the promise, the threat, and related matters
matn.chapter: Division 6 · The return, the promise, the threat, and related matters

matn.english: One must regret the bad because it is bad; otherwise repentance‎ [التوبة]‎ is absent. If fear of the Fire is the ultimate aim, the same applies; likewise with omission [of an obligation].
matn.arabic: ويندم على القبيح لقبحه وإلا انتفت وخوف النار إن كان الغاية فكذلك وكذا الإخلال. · ‎Āmulī pp. 417⁠–⁠418‎
matn.division: Division 6 · The return, the promise, the threat, and related matters
matn.chapter: Division 6 · The return, the promise, the threat, and related matters

matn.english: It therefore cannot be valid for some [bad acts alone]; and the analogy with performing an obligation does not hold.
matn.arabic: فلا تصح من البعض ولا يتم القياس على الواجب.
matn.division: Division 6 · The return, the promise, the threat, and related matters
matn.chapter: Division 6 · The return, the promise, the threat, and related matters

matn.english: But if he believes [the unrepented act] to be good, it is valid.
matn.arabic: ولو اعتقد فيه الحسن صحت.
matn.division: Division 6 · The return, the promise, the threat, and related matters
matn.chapter: Division 6 · The return, the promise, the threat, and related matters

matn.english: The same applies when an [unrepented] wrong is regarded as negligible [beside the graver wrong repented of].
matn.arabic: وكذا المستحقر. · ‎Āmulī pp. 419‎
matn.division: Division 6 · The return, the promise, the threat, and related matters
matn.chapter: Division 6 · The return, the promise, the threat, and related matters

matn.english: The correct analysis is that a preponderant motive‎ [الداعي]‎ for remorse over some [bad acts] brings it about, although the motive for regretting the bad is shared, just as with motives for action. If the preponderance were shared, the occurrence of remorse would also be shared. The words of the Commander of the Faithful and his descendants—peace be upon them—are to be interpreted accordingly. Otherwise one would have to judge unbelief‎ [الكفر]‎ to persist in a person who repents of it while continuing in a minor sin.
matn.arabic: والتحقيق أن ترجيح الداعي إلى الندم عن البعض يبعث عليه وإن اشترك الداعي في الندم على القبيح كما في الدواعي إلى الفعل ولو اشترك الترجيح اشترك وقوع الندم وبه يتأول كلام أمير المؤمنين وأولاده عليهم‌السلام وإلا لزم الحكم ببقاء الكفر على التائب منه المقيم على صغيرة. · ‎Āmulī pp. 420‎
matn.division: Division 6 · The return, the promise, the threat, and related matters
matn.chapter: Division 6 · The return, the promise, the threat, and related matters

matn.english: If a sin against His—Most High—right consists in a bad act, remorse and resolve [not to return to it] suffice. For omitting an obligation, the ruling differs according to whether [the obligation] remains due, requires later performance, or neither. If the sin concerns a human being’s right, it is followed by restoring that right when it was an injustice‎ [الظلم]‎—or resolving to restore it when unable—or by giving guidance when it was misguidance. These are not constituent parts [of repentance]‎ [التوبة]‎.
matn.arabic: والذنب إن كان في حقه تعالى من فعل قبيح كفى فيه الندم والعزم وفي الإخلال بالواجب اختلف حكمه من بقائه وقضائه وعدمهما وإن كان في حق آدمي استتبع إيصاله إن كان ظلما أو العزم عليه مع التعذر أو الإرشاد إن كان إضلالا وليس ذلك أجزاء.
matn.division: Division 6 · The return, the promise, the threat, and related matters
matn.chapter: Division 6 · The return, the promise, the threat, and related matters

matn.english: One must apologize to the person one has backbitten when [the backbiting] has come to his attention.
matn.arabic: ويجب الاعتذار إلى المغتاب مع بلوغه. · ‎Āmulī pp. 421⁠–⁠422‎
matn.division: Division 6 · The return, the promise, the threat, and related matters
matn.chapter: Division 6 · The return, the promise, the threat, and related matters

matn.english: There is difficulty concerning the requirement [to repent] in detail when [the sins] are remembered.
matn.arabic: وفي إيجاب التفصيل مع الذكر إشكال.
matn.division: Division 6 · The return, the promise, the threat, and related matters
matn.chapter: Division 6 · The return, the promise, the threat, and related matters

matn.english: There is also difficulty concerning the obligation to renew [repentance‎ [التوبة]‎ when a sin is remembered again].
matn.arabic: وفي وجوب التجديد إشكال.
matn.division: Division 6 · The return, the promise, the threat, and related matters
matn.chapter: Division 6 · The return, the promise, the threat, and related matters

matn.english: Likewise concerning [repentance‎ [التوبة]‎ for] the effect together with its cause [before the effect has occurred].
matn.arabic: وكذا المعلول مع العلة.
matn.division: Division 6 · The return, the promise, the threat, and related matters
matn.chapter: Division 6 · The return, the promise, the threat, and related matters

matn.english: And [likewise, there is difficulty concerning] the necessity‎ [الوجوب]‎ of punishment‎ [العقاب]‎’s being remitted through it.
matn.arabic: ووجوب سقوط العقاب بها. · ‎Āmulī pp. 422⁠–⁠423‎
matn.division: Division 6 · The return, the promise, the threat, and related matters
matn.chapter: Division 6 · The return, the promise, the threat, and related matters

matn.english: Punishment‎ [العقاب]‎ is remitted through [repentance]‎ [التوبة]‎, not through the abundance of its reward‎ [الثواب]‎, since it may occur with [its reward] nullified. Otherwise there would be no difference between preceding and following [the sin], and no restriction [to the sin repented of]. It is not accepted in the hereafter because the condition is absent.
matn.arabic: والعقاب يسقط بها لا بكثرة ثوابها لأنها قد تقع محبطة ولولاه لا يبقى الفرق بين التقدم والتأخر ولا اختصاص ولا تقبل في الآخرة لانتفاء الشرط. · ‎Āmulī pp. 424‎
matn.division: Division 6 · The return, the promise, the threat, and related matters
matn.chapter: Division 6 · The return, the promise, the threat, and related matters

matn.english: Punishment in the grave‎ [عذاب القبر]‎ occurs, because it is possible and because recurrently transmitted‎ [المتواتر]‎ revelation attests its occurrence.
matn.arabic: وعذاب القبر واقع لإمكانه وتواتر السمع بوقوعه.
matn.division: Division 6 · The return, the promise, the threat, and related matters
matn.chapter: Division 6 · The return, the promise, the threat, and related matters

matn.english: The other matters received through revelation—the Balance, the Path, the Reckoning, and the flying forth of the records—are possible, and transmitted revelation‎ [السمع]‎ indicates their reality; they must therefore be affirmed.
matn.arabic: وسائر السمعيات من الميزان والصراط والحساب وتطاير الكتب ممكنة دل السمع على ثبوتها فيجب التصديق بها. · ‎Āmulī pp. 424⁠–⁠425‎
matn.division: Division 6 · The return, the promise, the threat, and related matters
matn.chapter: Division 6 · The return, the promise, the threat, and related matters

matn.english: Transmitted revelation‎ [السمع]‎ indicates that Paradise and the Fire have already been created; the opposing texts are subject to interpretation.
matn.arabic: والسمع دل على أن الجنة والنار مخلوقتان الآن والمعارضات متأولة. · ‎Āmulī pp. 426‎
matn.division: Division 6 · The return, the promise, the threat, and related matters
matn.chapter: Division 6 · The return, the promise, the threat, and related matters

matn.english: Faith‎ [الإيمان]‎ is assent‎ [التصديق]‎ by heart and tongue. The first alone does not suffice, because of His—Most High—saying, ‘Their souls were certain of them’, and similar texts; nor does the second alone, because of His saying, ‘Say: You have not believed.’
matn.arabic: والإيمان التصديق بالقلب واللسان ولا يكفي الأول لقوله تعالى (وَاسْتَيْقَنَتْها أَنْفُسُهُمْ) ونحوه ولا الثاني لقوله (قُلْ لَمْ تُؤْمِنُوا).
matn.division: Division 6 · The return, the promise, the threat, and related matters
matn.chapter: Division 6 · The return, the promise, the threat, and related matters

matn.english: Unbelief‎ [الكفر]‎ is the absence of faith‎ [الإيمان]‎, whether accompanied by its contrary or not. Transgression‎ [الفسق]‎ (fisq) is departure from obedience to God Most High while retaining faith. Hypocrisy‎ [النفاق]‎ is displaying faith while concealing unbelief.
matn.arabic: والكفر عدم الإيمان إما مع الضد أو بدونه والفسق الخروج عن طاعة الله تعالى مع الإيمان والنفاق إظهار الإيمان وإخفاء الكفر.
matn.division: Division 6 · The return, the promise, the threat, and related matters
matn.chapter: Division 6 · The return, the promise, the threat, and related matters

matn.english: The transgressor is a believer, because the definition [of a believer] is realised in him.
matn.arabic: والفاسق مؤمن لوجود حده فيه. · ‎Āmulī pp. 426⁠–⁠427‎
matn.division: Division 6 · The return, the promise, the threat, and related matters
matn.chapter: Division 6 · The return, the promise, the threat, and related matters

matn.english: Enjoining what is obligatorily right is obligatory, as is forbidding wrong. [Enjoining] what is recommended is recommended. [These rulings are established] by transmitted revelation‎ [السمع]‎; otherwise either something contrary to actuality or a failure in His—Most High—wisdom‎ [الحكمة]‎ would follow.
matn.arabic: والأمر بالمعروف الواجب واجب وكذا النهي عن المنكر ، والمندوب مندوب سمعا وإلا لزم خلاف الواقع أو الإخلال بحكمته تعالى.
matn.division: Division 6 · The return, the promise, the threat, and related matters
matn.chapter: Division 6 · The return, the promise, the threat, and related matters

matn.english: Their conditions are that the person undertaking them knows the relevant moral status, considers that they may be effective, and [anticipates] no harmful consequence.
matn.arabic: وشروطهما علم فاعلهما بالوجه وتجويز التأثير وانتفاء المفسدة. · ‎Āmulī pp. 427⁠–⁠428‎
matn.division: Division 6 · The return, the promise, the threat, and related matters
matn.chapter: Division 6 · The return, the promise, the threat, and related matters
